item.title: IBM raises annual software revenue outlook as deal delays ease
item.description: IBM finance chief James Kavanaugh on Wednesday said delayed software deals that rattled investors in the last quarter were beginning to close, as the company lifted its forecast for the business and reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings.
item.dc:creator: Anhata Rooprai
item.content:encoded: IBM (IBM.N) finance chief James Kavanaugh on Wednesday said delayed software deals that rattled investors in the last quarter were beginning to close, as the company lifted its forecast for the business and reported better-than-expected third-quarter earnings. In an interview with Reuters, Kavanaugh said IBM now expects annual software revenue growth of about 7% to 8%, up from 6% to 8% previously. IBM's shares rose about 4% in extended trading. Here are some more details: Third-quarter revenue rose 4.7% to $17.10 billion, above analysts' average estimate of $16.82 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG Adjusted profit came in at $2.95 per share, beating estimates of $2.86 per share CEO Arvind Krishna had said in July that IBM had [USN:L4N43G13P TEXT:""faltered" in adapting"] to a shift in customer spending from software to data-center infrastructure, triggering its steepest one-day share drop in over a century Software revenue rose 8.3% to $7.80 billion in the third quarter, topping estimates of $7.62 billion Within the segment, sales in its hybrid cloud unit grew 11% and transaction processing software revenue rose 9%, rebounding from an unexpected decline last quarter Kavanaugh said about 25% of the transaction processing revenue came from deals deferred from the second quarter and "the remaining 75% is net new business" Infrastructure revenue rose 4.2% to $3.71 billion, as 31% growth in distributed infrastructure, which includes servers and storage systems, helped offset weakness in its Z mainframe business

item.title: El Salvador says Haiti gangs holding 4 force members hostage, announces new rescue mission
item.description: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele on Wednesday said that Haitian gangs were holding four Salvadaron members of an international UN-backed security force hostage, and that he had launched a military operation to being them back unharmed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Salvador's President Nayib Bukele on Wednesday said that Haitian gangs were holding four Salvadaron members of an international UN-backed security force hostage, and that he had launched a military operation to being them back unharmed. El Salvador's military and the Gang Suppression Force, mandated to help Haitian police fight powerful gangs, earlier this week announced efforts to recover the missing Salvadorans, but said intense fighting in the area had limited access. "Today, we have launched a military operation to rescue them," Bukele said, without providing further details about the operation or identifying the group holding the Salvadorans hostage. The Gang Suppression Force did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The four Salvadorans went missing on Sunday after they [USN:L1N4650NL TEXT:"leapt from a burning armored vehicle"] that was ambushed by armed gangs on the outskirts of the capital while returning from a market to their base, security officials said. Haitian gangs have cemented their influence over the capital and expanded to surrounding regions over recent years off the back of a longstanding political vacuum, widespread extortion and a flow of [USN:L8N3EF7DZ TEXT:"illegal arms"] largely from the US. Several nations including Chad and Sri Lanka have deployed soldiers as part of the Gang Suppression Force, which a year into its mandate has reached just over a third of its planned size and has had limited impact on Haiti's security. Bukele said the missing men were aviation technicians, not combatants. "Our mission consists only of pilots and technical personnel, whose primary job is to carry out medical evacuations and save lives, not to wage war," he said in a post X.

item.title: Ukrainian capital under missile attack, explosions seen in city
item.description: Russian forces attacked the Ukrainian capital Kyiv with ballistic missiles on Wednesday evening, damaging homes and a petrol station and causing injuries, officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Russian forces attacked the Ukrainian capital Kyiv with ballistic missiles on Wednesday evening, damaging homes and a petrol station and causing injuries, officials said. The city's military administration said missiles hit some private homes, as well as a petrol station on the eastern side of the Dnipro River that bisects the city. It said there were injuries, but provided no details. Mayor Vitali Klitschko said on Telegram that the city had come under missile attack and urged residents to remain in shelters. Reuters witnesses reported explosions in the city.

item.title: Tesla posts surprise positive cash flow on lower-than-expected AI spending
item.description: Tesla reported a surprise positive cash flow on Wednesday in the third quarter as it spent far less on its AI and robotics ambitions than Wall Street expected, as the EV maker weighs a merger with CEO Elon Musk's rocket company, SpaceX .
item.dc:creator: Akash Sriram, Abhirup Roy
item.content:encoded: Tesla (TSLA.O) reported a surprise positive cash flow on Wednesday in the third quarter as it spent far less on its AI and robotics ambitions than Wall Street expected, as the EV maker weighs a merger with CEO Elon Musk's rocket company, SpaceX (SPCX.O) . Tesla is walking a tightrope. The unexpected cash flow could bolster its case as investors weigh its value in a potential merger. But with much of its value tied to AI, robotaxis and humanoid robots, preserving cash at the expense of investment could undermine the very growth story investors are betting on. "Capex seems to be the magic number," said Ryan Lee, senior vice president of product and strategy at Direxion, which offers ETFs tied to Tesla. "The market continues to behave like Goldilocks — we don't want to see too much or too little here." Tesla shares were up about half a percent in after-hours trading. Capital expenditure at $4.7 billion was still more than double that of a year ago, but lower than last quarter and the $7.5 billion analysts on average were expecting, according to LSEG data. Free cash flow in the September quarter came in at $1.53 billion, compared with an expectation of cash burn of $4.92 billion. The company also beat Wall Street estimates for third-quarter revenue as a rebound in vehicle deliveries, helped by high gasoline prices, especially in Europe, and growth in its energy storage unit lifted sales. Musk said on Tuesday that a merger between Tesla and SpaceX was a "good idea" and that the companies had formed [USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"special committees"] to discuss a deal. "The merger still faces a high bar, but tonight’s numbers make the financial logic harder to ignore," said Thomas Monteiro, a senior analyst at Investing.com. "The main takeaway is that Tesla's surprisingly positive cash flow quarter did not come from stronger profits, but from spending billions less than planned at a time when SpaceX is preparing to invest up to $40 billion in a single quarter." REVENUE BEATS ESTIMATES ON DELIVERY REBOUND The Austin, Texas-based automaker reported revenue of $28.05 billion for the three months ended September 30, compared with analysts' average estimate of $27.88 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Revenue was $28.10 billion in the year-earlier quarter. Automotive gross margin, excluding regulatory credits, came in at 18.1% in the third quarter, higher than analysts’ estimates of 16.7%, according to Visible Alpha data. Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in the third quarter, beating Wall Street expectations of about 461,100 vehicles. Deliveries were down about 2% from a year earlier. Its core automotive business remains under scrutiny as rivals globally launch newer, often cheaper models, while Tesla leans heavily on the aging Model 3 and Model Y. It has said it passed 10 million vehicles delivered and that Model Y is on track to be the world's best-selling vehicle this year. To stimulate demand, Tesla has offered stripped-down, cheaper versions of both models and launched a six-seater Model Y in the United States in July. However, US demand was hit by the removal of tax credits last year. ROBOTAXI FLEET EXPANDS ACROSS US CITIES Investors have been keen to see clearer evidence that Musk's push into self-driving and robotics is moving from promise to commercial reality. Tesla said earlier this month that its Cybercab fleet in Austin had grown from fewer than 40 vehicles to more than 300 in about a month, with Dallas next. It launched unsupervised robotaxi rides in the Florida cities of Miami, Orlando and Tampa in July, after launching in Dallas and Houston in April. Tesla's energy unit has become a key counterweight to the auto business, helped by demand for grid-scale batteries from renewable-power developers and data centers. Tesla has said the current tariff regime will hit its energy business harder than its auto business. The company's shares have fallen about 14% this year. At roughly $1.4 trillion, it remains the world's most valuable automaker by a wide margin, reflecting investor expectations that self-driving software, energy storage, robotaxis and humanoid robots could eventually deliver higher-margin growth than vehicle sales.

item.title: Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh enters race for UN chief
item.description: Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh entered the race to become the next United Nations secretary-general on Wednesday, injecting a prominent Middle Eastern candidate into a contest that has struggled to produce a consensus choice among the Security Council’s most powerful members.
item.dc:creator: Maha Dahan
item.content:encoded: Senior UAE diplomat Lana Nusseibeh entered the race to become the next United Nations secretary-general on Wednesday, injecting a prominent Middle Eastern candidate into a contest that has struggled to produce a consensus choice among the Security Council’s most powerful members. Nusseibeh, a former UAE ambassador to the UN for more than a decade, told Reuters she would seek to restore the world body’s role as a diplomatic problem-solver at a time of mounting global crises. “It's clear that today we need a secretary-general that can recommit to the future of multilateralism and the future of the United Nations as a problem-solver rather than as a spectator to the world's crises,” she said shortly before going public with her candidacy. Nusseibeh, the UAE minister of state for foreign affairs, is a late entrant to the race. An informal Security Council poll had placed former Costa Rican Vice President [USN:L1N46112N TEXT:"Rebeca Grynspan"] as the narrow frontrunner, sources have said. Although Grynspan has led the informal "straw polls," last week she and all other candidates [USN:L1N4620XQ TEXT:"received"] two or more opposing votes from the ultimately decisive five permanent members of the council — Britain, China, France, Russia and the US. Council members are negotiating over whether to hold another poll this Friday or at a later stage. ENTREPRENEURIAL DIPLOMACY Nusseibeh, 48, said she was approached by multiple countries during the last UN General Assembly to put herself forward. She previously led the UAE's successful campaign for election to the Security Council. Diplomats in New York say she is respected as a competent manager. "It's recognized today that we need someone who offers generational change for the organization," she said. Her UN tenure overlapped with the outbreak of the Gaza war in 2023 when she secured the adoption of Resolution 2720 paving the way for the delivery of humanitarian aid. Nusseibeh said she secured support for the resolution by arranging a visit by council members to the Rafah border crossing to see for themselves the situation on the ground, describing the move as part of her "creative entrepreneurial diplomacy" that characterizes her approach. RELENTLESS DIPLOMACY As a top UAE diplomat, Nusseibeh has championed Abu Dhabi’s assertive foreign policy and heavy focus on countering political Islam. The UAE has faced criticism over Sudan after UN sanctions monitors described allegations that it provided military support to the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces as credible. The UAE denies the allegations. Asked how the allegations might affect her candidacy, Nusseibeh said she had taken leave from her UAE post and would focus on Sudan’s humanitarian crisis. A Nusseibeh victory would make her the second UN chief from the Middle East, after Egypt’s Boutros Boutros-Ghali. "I come from a country that is younger than the United Nations but our region is one that has been facing severe challenges," she said. She would also become the first woman to lead the UN, though Nusseibeh said she was not running on her gender. "I think it would be great if the next secretary-general was a woman but I'm not running because I'm a woman; I'm running because I am stubbornly optimistic about the future of the United Nations and I believe we need someone who is relentless in the pursuit of diplomacy to open doors."

item.title: Meta to issue new class of shares as it tightens AI spending forecast
item.description: Meta raised the lower end of its annual spending forecast on Wednesday and said it would introduce new non-voting shares, in a move that would help fund its costly AI expansion.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta (META.O) raised the lower end of its annual spending forecast on Wednesday and said it would introduce new non-voting shares, in a move that would help fund its costly AI expansion. Shares of the company rose more than 4% in extended trading, as it also forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates. The Facebook and Instagram parent has been pouring money into advanced chips and data centers to compete more aggressively with OpenAI and Anthropic, eroding its historically strong free cash flow. Meta will issue a new class of non-voting Class C common stock in January 2027, effectively resulting in a two-for-one split, to fund acquisitions and retain top talent while maintaining CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control amid Silicon Valley's intensifying AI race. The company now expects capital expenditure to be between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from $130 billion to $145 billion expected previously. The company reported better-than-expected revenue of $64.60 billion for the quarter ended September 30, ahead of Wall Street estimates of $63.37 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. The company projected fourth-quarter revenue between $73 billion and $76 billion, above estimates of $73.73 billion. Meta reported a free cash flow deficit of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier. "Our investments are paying off, the core business is strong, and we're seeing velocity across the board," Zuckerberg said in a statement. The early popularity of [USN:L6N4500XV TEXT:"its consumer-focused AI agent Muse"] and the release of a competitive new [USN:L4N45Y13Q TEXT:"series of AI models"] have helped Meta justify those investments to investors, even though some enterprises are restricting the agent's access over security concerns. Legal challenges are also mounting, including a $25 billion penalty [USN:L6N467165 TEXT:"ordered by a judge in New Mexico earlier"] on Wednesday after a jury found Meta misled the state's residents about how it shared user data with third parties and enforced policies on hate speech and misinformation in a case related to British political consulting firm Cambridge Analytica. In August, Meta [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"agreed to pay as much as $18 billion"] over a decade and restrict teenagers' use of Facebook and Instagram to settle claims by nearly all US states alleging that Meta's platforms were designed to addict children. The $25 billion penalty is a "stark reminder of the current legal challenges Meta faces, which will continue into next year," Emarketer senior analyst Minda Smiley said. "Questions and concerns related to privacy and safety will only ramp up should AI agents become more mainstream, which could ultimately hurt Meta considering its reputation in this area." Meta posted diluted earnings per share of $3.83 in the quarter, a figure that would have been $7.40, had it not been for a $9.89 billion charge related to the August settlement. The agreement [USN:L4N44N1N4 TEXT:"removed a significant regulatory hurdle"] that had weighed on Meta's stock and allowed the company to avoid a potentially lengthy trial that could have exposed more internal documents about its treatment of young users. Almost all of Meta's revenue comes from advertising, with Reels competing with TikTok and YouTube Shorts for dominance in the short-video market and Threads taking on Elon Musk's X, while its AI sharpens ad targeting and recommendations to boost user engagement.

item.title: Ibovespa tem ajuste negativo com pesquisa e WEG sob holofote
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quarta-feira, após ultrapassar os 209 mil pontos no melhor momento, em pregão de correção na bolsa paulista.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quarta-feira, após ultrapassar os 209 mil pontos no melhor momento, em pregão de correção na bolsa paulista. O cenário eleitoral continuou dominando o foco dos investidores, com nova pesquisa reforçando a disputa apertada na corrida eleitoral. Mas a temporada de balanços também ocupou as atenções com uma recepção negativa aos números de terceiro trimestre da WEG. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) recuou 0,86%, a 206.495,23 pontos, após marcar 209.244,71 na máxima do dia, registrada nos primeiros negócios. No pior momento, chegou a 205.988. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$38,6 bilhões. A piora do Ibovespa seguiu a divulgação de [USN:L6N4670YJ TEXT:"pesquisa Quaest, "]pelo jornal O Globo, com queda na vantagem numérica do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) para o segundo turno da eleição presidencial. O levantamento mostrou Flávio com 45% das intenções de votos e Lula com 44%, ainda em empate técnico. Na pesquisa anterior, há uma semana, Flávio aparecia com 46% e Lula registrava 44%. Após a euforia inicial do primeiro turno, com Flávio à frente de Lula, o Ibovespa tem oscilado sem uma direção única, com investidores ajustando as posições antes do resultado das urnas no próximo domingo. "O Ibovespa, definitivamente e sem dúvida, está reagindo ao noticiário político", afirmou o head da mesa de renda variável e sócio da AW Capital, Lucas Xavier. "Quanto mais provável o cenário de reeleição, mais cauteloso fica o mercado." Na visão de Xavier, até o fim desta semana, o mercado deve mostrar um movimento "mais lateral". "Acredito que não haverá grandes movimentos de alocação em um cenário tão próximo da eleição. Imagino que o mercado como um todo aguarde os resultados para fazer as movimentações necessárias em seus portfólios", afirmou. Dados atualizados da B3 também mostraram uma saída líquida de capital externo no último dia 19, levando o saldo positivo acumulado no mês para R$19,98 bilhões, de R$20,99 bilhões até o dia 16. O começo da safra de balanços do Brasil pouco animou, com WEG figurando entre as maiores perdas no dia, após um resultado ligeiramente abaixo das expectativas. Na quinta-feira, o destaque fica para os números do Bradesco sobre o terceiro trimestre, que serão divulgados após o fechamento do mercado. Estrategistas da XP afirmaram que suas estimativas apontam para uma temporada fraca, com desempenho mais positivo concentrado em poucos setores, notadamente óleo e gás e saúde, enquanto mineração e siderurgia e varejo foram apontados como destaques negativos. A correção negativa do Ibovespa contrastou com o viés em [USN:L6N46710Y TEXT:"Wall Street"], onde o S&P 500 (.SPX) fechou em alta de 0,58%, com os resultados trimestrais da SpaceX e da Super Micro Computer alimentando o interesse por ações ligadas à inteligência artificial. DESTAQUES WEG ON (WEGE3.SA) tombou 7,34% após [USN:L1N4670FP TEXT:"balanço"] do terceiro trimestre mostrar lucro líquido de R$1,67 bilhão e Ebitda de R$2,35 bilhões, ligeiramente abaixo de previsões de analistas. Analistas do UBS BB chamaram a atenção principalmente para a queda em margens da companhia. HAPVIDA ON (HAPV3.SA) desabou 8,48%, mais do que devolvendo a alta da véspera, quando fechou em alta de 7,55%. No mês, o papel ainda acumula um ganho de 31%. BTG PACTUAL UNIT caiu 1,41%, em dia sem tendência única para o setor, após desempenho robusto na véspera. BRADESCO PN , que divulga [USN:L6N4660V1 TEXT:"balanço"] no final da quinta-feira, cedeu 0,15% e BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) recuou 0,41%, enquanto ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN subiu 0,2% e SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT valorizou-se 0,9%. PETROBRAS PN cedeu 0,79%, em sessão sem direção definida dos preços do [USN:L6N4671AI TEXT:"petróleo"] no exterior. No fechamento, o barril sob o contrato Brent registrou variação positiva de 0,03%, a US$108,82. VALE ON (VALE3.SA) caiu 2,15%, em dia também negativo para o setor no exterior (.SXPP) , tendo como pano de fundo variações modestas dos futuros do [USN:L6N4670TC TEXT:"minério de ferro"] na China. Analistas do UBS BB reiteraram a recomendação neutra para as ações da mineradora brasileira e reduziram o preço-alvo dos papéis para R$73, ante R$77. TOTVS ON (TOTS3.SA) avançou 2,78%, caminhando para o quarto pregão seguido de alta, ajudada nessa sessão pelo movimento positivo do setor de tecnologia no exterior.

item.title: Bruins follow productive road trip with visit from Predators
item.description: The Boston Bruins are back from a road trip that they will not soon forget.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Boston Bruins are back from a road trip that they will not soon forget. With seven of a possible eight points in the bank over the last 10 days, Boston looks to maintain its momentum against the visiting Nashville Predators on Thursday night. The Bruins came up just short of a perfect trip, dropping a 3-2 overtime loss to the Dallas Stars on Tuesday after sweeping a three-game run through California. "It's hard to win in this league," Bruins goaltender Jeremy Swayman said. "We were all laughing -- it's been the best trip ever just because of the camaraderie, the way we've competed and been able to stick together every single day." Aside from Boston's power play being scoreless for the eighth time in 10 games (all six goals have come in the other two), coach Marco Sturm saw plenty to build upon moving forward. "(We were) right there. It's nice to see that every game was pretty consistent. For a coach, that's what you're looking for," he said. "Doesn't matter -- goalie, D, forwards -- every line did their job. We were very consistent, very structured, didn't give up much and got rewarded with some big points." Sturm also felt that facing a road challenge against a perennial contender would benefit his young players. Matthew Poitras and James Hagens scored against Dallas, while defenseman Frederic Brunet assisted Poitras with a perfect cross-ice pass. The 19-year-old Hagens, the seventh overall pick in the 2025 NHL Draft out of Boston College, has three goals this season and four points in his last five games. Poitras, meanwhile, matched David Pastrnak and Fraser Minten with a team-high four goals and is now riding a four-game point streak. "You could see it when you play a team like Dallas (with) a lot of veterans, and it's a little bit more playoff atmosphere," Sturm said. "You could tell they made a little bit more mistakes than some other games, but it's healthy, though. "It's going to help them moving forward," he added. One loss in overtime and two in shootouts through eight games have forced the Predators to settle for a 3-2-3 start. However, a 5-2 win over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday had them riding high heading into a brief hiatus before playing three games in four nights starting Thursday. "You want to build your game and you want to win consistently, but at the same time, a win is a win, and they're always fun," Nashville captain Roman Josi said. "We enjoyed it Saturday, but we're also realistic that we can get to another level." The Predators also will visit the Pittsburgh Penguins on Saturday before returning south for another five-game homestand. That time and an injury to forward Mavrik Bourque (upper body) allowed coach Andrew Brunette to experiment with different line combinations. Alexander Kerfoot, who has spent much of the season on the top-line wing alongside Ryan O'Reilly and Steven Stamkos, shifted to center on the second line with Ross Colton and Jonathan Marchessault. "(Kerfoot is) a stabilizing player for us in all kinds of different roles," Brunette said. "It seems like every line I put him on, that line's better. I think just through the middle of the ice, he gives us a little bit more reliability or stabilizing factor." In Saturday's win over the Blues, five different Predators scored goals, including Marchessault on a penalty shot and Adam Edstrom short-handed. Filip Forsberg had a goal and an assist, while defenseman Adam Wilsby dished out three assists for his first career three-point game. Juuse Saros (24 saves) has allowed only two goals or fewer in four of his seven starts, seeing 30 or more shots in five of them. "You talk about systems and all that, but he's probably the biggest reason why we've been staying in some of these games," defenseman Brady Skjei said of the Finnish backstop. --Field Level Media

item.title: Smith injury adds to Australia woes as defeat looms in second test
item.description: Australia will be hoping opener Travis Head goes on to post a big score in a rearguard action against South Africa on the last day of the second test on Thursday, but it remains unclear whether the injured Steve Smith will be able to help their cause.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia will be hoping opener Travis Head goes on to post a big score in a rearguard action against South Africa on the last day of the second test on Thursday, but it remains unclear whether the injured Steve Smith will be able to help their cause. Australia will resume on 156-4 in their second innings, after being asked to follow on, with Head on 87, needing effectively to bat for most of the fifth day to have any chance of avoiding defeat and preserving their lead in the three-match series. Head’s power hitting gives him the ability to take the fight to the bowlers and blunt the attack, but it is Smith’s vast experience that could be crucial to the tourists in their precarious position. The 37-year-old former captain was top scorer for Australia in their worst first-innings batting return in a decade as they were skittled out for 99. He batted, however, in obvious discomfort with a neck injury that required on-field treatment. Smith’s woes distracted from him reaching 11,000 test runs – the third Australian to achieve the feat after Allan Border and Ricky Ponting – before being bowled for 28 by Wiaan Mulder. He did not come out to bat in his regular No. 4 spot in the second innings, staying in the changing room with a brace around his neck. CHANGES ON THE CARDS FOR LAST TEST Whether the injury impacts his ability to play on Thursday or in next week’s final test is not clear, but already Australia’s woeful batting display suggests the selectors will be re-thinking the line-up for Cape Town. Marnus Labuschagne, Nic Maddinson and Beau Webster should all be in the spotlight when the panel sits down ahead of next Tuesday’s start. "I'm not going to sit here and hang anyone out to dry,” coach Andrew McDonald told reporters on Wednesday when asked about possible changes, but he acknowledged his side had suffered a "significant setback". "It was only a week ago we were a really, really good team," he added. Labuschagne has now gone 46 test innings without scoring a century, and his second dismissal on Wednesday put his approach in the spotlight, leaving his side further in the mire. He and Head had put on 92 for the second wicket as the home bowlers tired but instead of continuing the fightback, Labuschagne took on spinner Simon Harmer in a fierce gale and was caught skying a rash shot, precipitating the fall of two more Australia wickets before stumps. "There's probably some shots players would like to take back," McDonald said. "When you do that hard work, you've got to cash in, and unfortunately that wasn't the case for Marn. He’d be disappointed, we're disappointed and we find ourselves in this situation," the coach added.

item.title: Pennsylvania measles cases rise to 1,317, state health department says
item.description: The Pennsylvania Department of Health on Wednesday reported 1,317 measles cases in the state, up 31 cases since its previous update on Monday, as the outbreak of the highly contagious disease continued.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Pennsylvania Department of Health on Wednesday reported 1,317 measles cases in the state, up 31 cases since its previous update on Monday, as the outbreak of the highly contagious disease continued. Pennsylvania has confirmed measles cases in 43 counties, with Washington County added to the list of affected counties. Measles-related hospitalizations this year rose to 251 from 247 reported on Monday, according to state health department data The state has reported five measles-related deaths so far in 2026. The health department said 4 of the 1,317 cases, or less than 1%, were among vaccinated individuals. The CDC [USN:L4N45Z1Q3 TEXT:"said"] last week it would deploy additional support to Pennsylvania to help investigate the outbreak

item.title: Multimillonario británico Branson dice que inversionistas esperarán a elecciones en Venezuela
item.description: Venezuela recibirá más inversiones cuando el país tenga elecciones, dijo el miércoles el multimillonario británico y propietario de Virgin Group, Richard Branson, en momentos en que el país sudamericano vuelve a recibir capitales en sectores como petróleo y gas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Venezuela recibirá más inversiones cuando el país tenga elecciones, dijo el miércoles el multimillonario británico y propietario de Virgin Group, Richard Branson, en momentos en que el país sudamericano vuelve a recibir capitales en sectores como petróleo y gas. Branson participó en un evento con empresarios y representantes de fondos de inversión que buscan apoyar emprendimientos en el país, donde además estuvieron presentes el canciller venezolano, Félix Plasencia, y el ministro de Industria, Luis Villegas. "Venezuela necesita que los inversores extranjeros sepan que muchos esperarán a que se celebren las elecciones y se establezca el estado de derecho antes de invertir en Venezuela. Pero estoy seguro de que, una vez que haya elecciones, la gente estará dispuesta a invertir en Venezuela", agregó el empresario. "Mucho depende, obviamente, de los próximos 18 meses. Y creo que una vez que se hayan celebrado las elecciones y se hayan establecido todas las normas de derecho, Venezuela tendrá una tremenda oportunidad de cara al futuro", dijo Branson, sin precisar las razones o detalles del plazo mencionado. La presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, que asumió el poder tras la captura del entonces presidente Nicolás Maduro en una operación estadounidense en enero y cuenta con el respaldo de Washington, prometió en su discurso ante la ONU en septiembre que en el país habrá [USN:L6N45F1A8 TEXT:"elecciones"], pero no mencionó una fecha. El Gobierno de Rodríguez ha firmado en los últimos meses acuerdos para los sectores de petróleo, gas y electricidad. Pero pese a las reformas legales avaladas por el Parlamento venezolano, aún [USN:L6N4291BF TEXT:"inversores globales"] están reticentes a firmar convenios en diferentes sectores, porque siguen desconfiando del sistema legal. "La inversión necesita certeza. Necesita un proceso judicial adecuado y seguridad jurídica. Necesita transparencia. El acceso al capital necesita saber que el capital está seguro", añadió el empresario británico, que no detalló si tendría interés en participar en algunos sectores en Venezuela. Branson dijo que los emprendedores deberían ser la "columna vertebral del país", por ser generadores de empleos.

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、原油高によるインフレ懸念を警戒 ＦＯＭＣ控え
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル軟調、原油高によるインフレ懸念を警戒　ＦＯＭＣ控え 4:48 配信

２０２５年５月撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

［ニューヨーク　２１日　ロイター］ - ニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対して下落した。米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）を来週に控え、市場では原油高に伴うインフレ再燃リスクが意識されている。

終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．０２％高の１５８．１２円。 日銀の氷見野良三副総裁は衆院財務金融委員会で、９月の利上げについて、中長期の予想物価上昇率が引き続き上昇していることも踏まえれば「基調的な物価上昇率は２％にかなり近づいており、先行き物価安定の目標とおおむね整合的な水準となる」と指摘。こうした中心的な見通しに加え、金融環境が緩和的な状態にあることや物価の上振れリスクに留意する必要があることなどを踏まえて決めたとし、利上げ後も「緩和的な金融環境は維持されており、引き続き経済活動はしっかりとサポートされている」と述べた。

主要通貨に対するドル指数＜＝USD＞は０．１４％安の１０１．６５。ユーロは対ドルで０．０１％高の１．１２３７ドル。

スコシアバンクのショーン・オズボーン主任ＦＸストラテジストは、「市場全体を左右する明確なテーマは現在のところ見当たらない。少なくとも来週のＦＯＭＣまでこうした状況が続く」と指摘。「連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が何を考えているのかを見極める必要がある」としている。

米国とイランの戦闘の終着点が見えない中、原油価格上昇を通じたインフレ圧力がＦＲＢの政策に影響を及ぼすとの懸念が高まっている。ＦＲＢが２７─２８日のＦＯＭＣで追加利上げに動く可能性は小さいとみられており、次回の利上げは１２月８─９日の会合になるとの見方が優勢。来週のＦＯＭＣでウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が今後の政策運営について明確に示唆する可能性も低いとみられている。ただ、スコシアバンクのオズボーン氏は、今後の金利見通しや利上げ時期を巡る市場の見方は、来週にはある程度固まるとの見方を示している。

市場では、ＡＩ（人工知能）関連銘柄を中心とした相場上昇の持続可能性を巡る懸念も払しょくされていない。ＣＩＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツのＦＸストラテジスト、ノア・バファム氏は「米国の成長はＡＩ相場によって大きくけん引されてきた。米国のインフレ率が（ＦＲＢの）目標を超える水準にとどまる要因にもなっており、米国は他の国よりも大きな影響を受けている」と述べた。

ユーロに対しては、フランスで反政府デモが広がっていることや財政見通しの悪化がこのところ重しになっている。仏１０年債利回りはこの日の取引で２００２年７月以来初めて５％台に乗せた。コペンハーゲンに拠点を置くサクソのグローバル・マクロ戦略責任者、ジョン・ハーディ氏は「フランスの債務問題は容易に解決できる状況ではない。債務残高の増加に歯止めをかける真剣な姿勢を示すためにも、政府は財政面で適切な調整を実施する必要がある」と述べた。

item.title: Tom Cruise recibirá un premio del American Film Institute
item.description: El actor Tom Cruise, conocido por películas que van desde "Negocios riesgosos" hasta "Top Gun", recibirá el Premio a la Trayectoria Profesional del American Film Institute (AFI) en una ceremonia que se celebrará en Hollywood en abril, informaron los organizadores el miércoles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El actor Tom Cruise, conocido por películas que van desde "Negocios riesgosos" hasta "Top Gun", recibirá el Premio a la Trayectoria Profesional del American Film Institute (AFI) en una ceremonia que se celebrará en Hollywood en abril, informaron los organizadores el miércoles. El AFI, una organización sin ánimo de lucro dedicada a la conservación y promoción del cine, concede este premio anualmente desde 1973. Entre los galardonados anteriores se encuentran Bette Davis, Gene Kelly, Elizabeth Taylor y Tom Hanks. Cruise es conocido en la industria como uno de los mayores defensores del cine. "Como actor y productor, aporta un compromiso extraordinario a todo lo que hace", afirmó la productora Kathleen Kennedy, presidenta del consejo de administración del AFI. "Lo que más admiro es su profunda fe en el cine y en su capacidad para unir a las personas". Cruise ha sido nominado a tres premios Óscar por su interpretación y recibió un Óscar honorífico el año pasado por toda su trayectoria profesional. Entre sus películas se encuentran "Jerry Maguire", "Minority Report", "Cuestión de honor", "Rain Man" y la saga "Misión: Imposible". La última película de Cruise, la comedia negra de gran presupuesto "Digger", no ha tenido mucho éxito en taquilla, quedando en quinto lugar en las listas de Estados Unidos y Canadá durante su primer fin de semana en octubre.

item.title: Commanders add longtime defensive coach Steve Wilks as part-time staffer
item.description: The Washington Commanders hired longtime NFL coach Steve Wilks as a part-time assistant to work with the defensive coaching staff, according to multiple reports Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Washington Commanders hired longtime NFL coach Steve Wilks as a part-time assistant to work with the defensive coaching staff, according to multiple reports Wednesday. Wilks, who officially started in his role last week, assists head coach Dan Quinn and first-year defensive coordinator Daronte Jones with game-planning but is not with the team on game days, according to the reports. Wilks' hiring had been before the start of the season, per reports. Wilks, 57, was the head coach of the Arizona Cardinals in 2018 when the team went 3-13 and was interim head coach of the Carolina Panthers in 2022 when the team went 6-6 under his leadership. He was fired in his first season as the New York Jets' defensive coordinator on Dec. 15, 2025, after a 48-20 loss to the host Jacksonville Jaguars that dropped the team to 3-11. Wilks also worked as the defensive coordinator for the San Francisco 49ers (2023), Panthers (2022, 2017), University of Missouri (2021) and Cleveland Browns (2019). He has been coaching in college and the NFL since 1995. Jones, 47, is in his first year with Washington after five seasons as a defensive assistant coach with the Minnesota Vikings (2020; 2022-2025). He also was defensive coordinator at LSU in 2021. He broke into the NFL ranks as an assistant defensive backs coach with the Miami Dolphins (2016-17) and also was a secondary/cornerbacks coach with the Cincinnati Bengals (2018-19). --Field Level Media

item.title: Nuevo México demanda a exabogado y a contable de Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: Nuevo México presentó una demanda civil contra el exabogado y el contable de Jeffrey Epstein para bloquear los pagos procedentes del patrimonio del fallecido delincuente sexual y obtener una indemnización por daños y perjuicios para las víctimas de sus presuntos abusos sexuales, informó el miércoles el máximo responsable de las fuerzas del orden del estado.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Hay
item.content:encoded: Nuevo México presentó una demanda civil contra el exabogado y el contable de Jeffrey Epstein para bloquear los pagos procedentes del patrimonio del fallecido delincuente sexual y obtener una indemnización por daños y perjuicios para las víctimas de sus presuntos abusos sexuales, informó el miércoles el máximo responsable de las fuerzas del orden del estado. La demanda es la primera acción judicial contra el abogado personal de Epstein desde hacía mucho tiempo, Darren Indyke, y el contable Richard Kahn, según un comunicado del fiscal general de Nuevo México, Raúl Torres. En febrero, este estado, gobernado por el Partido Demócrata, reabrió una investigación sobre las actividades en el antiguo rancho de Epstein en Nuevo México, donde se le acusa de haber abusado de mujeres y niñas durante casi tres décadas. La demanda alega que Indyke y Kahn facilitaron, financiaron y encubrieron la red de tráfico sexual de Epstein, incluso en el rancho Zorro, situado a 30 millas al sur de Santa Fe, la capital del estado. También cita al patrimonio de Jeffrey Epstein y pretende prohibir que su fideicomiso privado —creado días antes de su muerte por suicidio en una celda de Manhattan— gaste nada de los más de 100 millones de dólares que posee. Los abogados de Indyke y Kahn no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. "Jeffrey Epstein no actuaba solo, y su muerte no pone fin a la búsqueda de responsabilidades por parte de quienes contribuyeron a que sus delitos fueran posibles", afirmó Torrez en una rueda de prensa celebrada en Albuquerque en la que fue acompañado por Julia Molchanova y Anouska De Georgiou, supervivientes de los presuntos abusos de Epstein. La demanda pondrá a prueba si las autoridades son capaces de corroborar las acusaciones de que una red de personas y acuerdos financieros ayudó a mantener y ocultar el comportamiento de Epstein durante décadas. Nuevo México es el único estado de Estados Unidos que ha puesto en marcha una "comisión de la verdad" legislativa para investigar los presuntos vínculos del financiero con políticos locales y funcionarios del Gobierno. El estado ha demandado al Departamento de Justicia de Estados Unidos para obtener acceso a los expedientes sin censurar sobre Epstein, acusando al Gobierno de Donald Trump de obstaculizar su investigación. El Departamento de Justicia afirmó que había facilitado algunos expedientes, pero que no pudo entregar la mayor parte del material debido a las protecciones de la privacidad. La relación de Trump con Epstein, que se prolongó durante años, ha lastrado su presidencia, y los demócratas del Congreso siguen exigiendo la publicación de millones de documentos relacionados con sus actividades.

item.title: 仏「黄色いベスト」、24日にパリでデモ 政権は暴動防止を言明
item.description:
Elizabeth Pineau Dominique Patton
[パリ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Elizabeth Pineau　Dominique Patton

[パリ ２１日 ロイター] - フランス各地で抗議デモが繰り広げられる中、２０１８年にも抗議活動を行った団体「黄色いベスト」運動は、パリ中心部で２４日にデモ行進する計画を示した。教育環境改善を求める学生団体も同日の抗議行動を呼びかけている。

マクロン大統領は２１日、抗議デモに乗じた略奪や暴動などの再発を防ぐと言明した。ルコルニュ首相は、労働組合の指導者らと会談。閣僚らは初期対応の不備を認め、警察隊のほか軍隊も配備し、警備態勢を強化する方針だ。

カタールを訪問中のマクロン氏は、燃料費の上昇抑制につなげようとエネルギー関連の合意を目指している。２２日には情報機関当局者、ルコルニュ氏らと会合を開き、今回の混乱の詳細の説明を受ける予定。

先週末にフランス各地で行われた抗議デモは、パリやマルセイユ、リヨンなどで暴動や略奪といった暴力行為に発展。警察隊は事態の収拾までに数時間を要した。財政問題や政治への不安が高まり、フランス国債の利回りは今週、上昇している。

フランスの主要労働組合は１１月５日に全国的な動員を呼びかけている。仏労働総同盟（ＣＧＴ）の代表は、弾圧ではなく、政治的な対応で応じるべきとの見解を示した。

マクロン氏は、一部の外国の指導者が誤った情報を流していると非難した。フランスでの抗議拡大を巡っては、トランプ米大統領が移民問題を指摘していた。フランスの極右政党、国民連合（ＲＮ）の実質的な指導者マリーヌ・ルペン氏は「政府は何も制御できなくなっている」と主張した。

item.title: DOJ seeks to bar Minnesota judges from two cases over statements on Trump immigration surge
item.description: The US Justice Department is seeking to have two Minnesota federal judges step aside from separate cases after they gave interviews to the New York Times about pressures their court faced as a result of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown in their state.
item.dc:creator: Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department is seeking to have two Minnesota federal judges step aside from separate cases after they gave interviews to the New York Times about pressures their court faced as a result of the Trump administration's immigration crackdown in their state. Associate Attorney General Stanley Woodward made the recusal requests in a pair of court filings on Tuesday, a month after the Trump administration filed a related [USN:S0N43J04L TEXT:"judicial misconduct complaint"] against US District Judges Patrick Schiltz and John Tunheim. "Impartiality is imperative to ensuring public trust in our Nation's judiciary," the Justice Department said in a social media post on X announcing the motions. Rebecca Parks, a spokesperson for the US District Court for the District of Minnesota, declined to comment, saying the judges could not comment on matters pending in the court. In a statement last month, Parks told Reuters that the judges had acted "well within the ethical rules that apply to federal judges in speaking to the New York Times." The judges spoke to the newspaper for an article that was published on September 17 about the cases that flooded their court last winter during "Operation Metro Surge," which led to hundreds of immigration-related arrests in Minnesota. Schiltz at the time of the surge was the district's chief judge. In an [USN:L6N3YT15W TEXT:"order in January"], he took US Immigration and Customs Enforcement to task for violating nearly 100 orders during the surge as the court grappled with cases by people saying they were unlawfully detained. The New York Times said that Schiltz, an appointee of Republican President George W. Bush, described why he issued that order and said what happened in his court "created a grave threat to the rule of law." Woodward, the DOJ's third-highest ranking official, in one of Tuesday's motions cited that and other statements to argue that Schiltz had engaged in "a partisan critique of the Trump Administration’s immigration enforcement." He said the statements called the judge's impartiality into question and warranted his recusal from a case the department filed in May seeking to denaturalize Salah Osman Ahmed, who pleaded guilty in 2009 to providing material support to terrorists by supporting the militant group al Shabaab. "A judge who has publicly taken sides on the political issue of immigration enforcement cannot then preside over a case concerning one of the Justice Department’s key immigration initiatives: pursuing the largest denaturalization effort in Department history to restore trust and integrity in US citizenship," Woodward wrote. A hearing before Schiltz on the motion is scheduled for November 23. Woodward made a similar request to have Tunheim, an appointee of Democratic President Bill Clinton, recuse himself from hearing a criminal case charging a South African woman with voting illegally and making a false claim of citizenship in order to vote. The request cited Tunheim's statement to the newspaper that authorities during the surge "weren’t arresting, in my view, people who were dangerous criminals on the street.” "That is not the law (or even about the law)," Woodward wrote. "But the law prohibits voting illegally. It also compels recusal when a judge’s partiality might reasonably be questioned." The cases in the US District Court for the District of Minnesota are US v Ahmed, No. 26-cv-02536, and US v Weihmann, 26-cr-175. Read more: [USN:S0N43J04L TEXT:"US Justice Department files complaint against Minnesota judges who gave interviews about immigration surge"] [USN:L6N3YT15W TEXT:"US judge cancels ICE chief contempt hearing after detainee released"]

item.title: Tom Cruise to be honored with American Film Institute award
item.description: Actor Tom Cruise, known for movies from "Risky Business" to "Top Gun," will receive the American Film Institute's Life Achievement Award at a Hollywood ceremony in April, organizers said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Actor Tom Cruise, known for movies from "Risky Business" to "Top Gun," will receive the American Film Institute's Life Achievement Award at a Hollywood ceremony in April, organizers said on Wednesday. The AFI, a nonprofit dedicated to preserving and promoting movies, has bestowed the honor annually since 1973. Previous recipients include Bette Davis, Gene Kelley, Elizabeth Taylor and Tom Hanks. Cruise is known throughout the film business as one of the biggest champions of cinemas. “As an actor and producer, he brings an extraordinary commitment to everything he does," said producer Kathleen Kennedy, chair of AFI's board of trustees. "What I especially admire is his deep belief in movies and their ability to bring people together." Cruise has been nominated for three Academy Awards for acting and received an honorary Oscar last year for his lifetime of work. His films include "Jerry Maguire," "Minority Report," "A Few Good Men," "Rain Man" and the "Mission: Impossible" series. Cruise's latest movie, the big-budget dark comedy "Digger," has struggled at the box office, finishing fifth on U.S. and Canadian charts in its opening weekend in October.

item.title: Anea eleva projeções de safra de algodão do Brasil e vê exportações em níveis recordes
item.description: A Associação Nacional dos Exportadores de Algodão (Anea) revisou para cima a safra de algodão do Brasil colhida neste ano e também elevou a projeção para a temporada 2026/27, citando uma possível janela favorável ao plantio no maior exportador global da pluma, conforme comunicado divulgado nesta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Associação Nacional dos Exportadores de Algodão (Anea) revisou para cima a safra de algodão do Brasil colhida neste ano e também elevou a projeção para a temporada 2026/27, citando uma possível janela favorável ao plantio no maior exportador global da pluma, conforme comunicado divulgado nesta quarta-feira. Grande parte do algodão cultivado no Brasil é plantado na segunda safra, notadamente em Mato Grosso, após a colheita da soja. Uma semeadura acelerada da oleaginosa no principal Estado produtor do país traz um cenário favorável. A estimativa de produção em 2026/27 foi ampliada em 5,9% em relação à previsão de agosto, para 4,267 milhões de toneladas. O volume ficaria próximo das 4,271 milhões de toneladas do ciclo anterior, cuja estimativa da Anea subiu 2,2% ante o volume previsto em agosto. "A revisão (de 2026/27) considera a janela favorável de plantio da soja e as indicações dos produtores sobre as projeções para o próximo ciclo", disse o presidente da Anea, Dawid Wajs, ponderando em nota que a entidade acompanha os riscos climáticos, especialmente aqueles relacionados ao El Niño. Com duas safras consecutivas em patamares recordes acima de 4,2 milhões de toneladas, o Brasil deverá manter volumes expressivos na exportação, já que a demanda está firme, disse Wajs. "A gente acredita que ainda o Brasil deve bater recorde de exportação no combinado de segundo semestre do ano 2026 com o primeiro semestre do ano 2027, porque temos safra consideravelmente grande e esse algodão tem que sair", disse. Os embarques no segundo semestre deste ano são estimados em cerca de 1,6 milhão de toneladas, enquanto no primeiro semestre do ano que vem são vistos em 1,8 milhão de toneladas, segundo a Anea, que debateu os números em reunião do Comitê de Oferta e Demanda da entidade na terça-feira. O presidente da Anea disse que o setor tem visto "crescimento muito relevante" no terceiro trimestre nas exportações de países como Índia, Bangladesh, Turquia e Vietnã. Com a produção elevada, a Anea também revisou os estoques de passagem em dezembro de 2026 para 3,038 milhões de toneladas, ante 2,914 milhões na previsão anterior.

item.title: Ukraine's Zelenskiy hopes for new talks with Russia, US by early November
item.description: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Wednesday that Ukraine supported a US proposal for three-way talks with Russia and the United States at the level of negotiators to be held as soon as possible, preferably no later than early November.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Wednesday that Ukraine supported a US proposal for three-way talks with Russia and the United States at the level of negotiators to be held as soon as possible, preferably no later than early November. Zelenskiy, speaking to journalists on WhatsApp as he returned to Kyiv from Norway, said he had spoken to US officials after presidential envoy Steve Witkoff's talks in St Petersburg with Russian President Vladimir Putin. "We have received feedback that...Russia supports a trilateral meeting at the level of our (negotiating) teams," Zelenskiy said. "The American side has proposed holding it as soon as possible and we support that...The Ukrainian side has been in contact with its American partners. They will do everything to ensure that the meeting takes place as early as possible, in November. I think no later than early November." Zelenskiy said that Kyiv supported "any proposals for a ceasefire, an end to the war, an energy ceasefire as well as humanitarian initiatives". Earlier, [USN:L6N4670P2 TEXT:"the Kremlin said"] Putin has agreed to resume US-mediated peace talks with Ukraine as soon as next month. Witkoff met Putin a day after holding talks with Zelenskiy in Norway amid concerns in Kyiv and among its allies that the United States was backing away from Ukraine.

item.title: Imágenes modificadas con IA muestran a manifestante en Francia con traje de la Pantera Rosa
item.description: Dos fotografías de protestas antiguas en Armenia y Grecia fueron modificadas con inteligencia artificial para incluir a un manifestante con el traje del personaje de dibujos animados Pantera Rosa y se compartieron en línea como registros auténticos de las protestas en Francia en 2026.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Dos fotografías de protestas antiguas en Armenia y Grecia fueron modificadas con inteligencia artificial para incluir a un manifestante con el traje del personaje de dibujos animados Pantera Rosa y se compartieron en línea como registros auténticos de las protestas en Francia en 2026. Francia registra una ola de [USN:L1N4650EF TEXT:"manifestaciones"] motivadas por el aumento del costo de la vida y la percepción de corrupción, que ha dado lugar a enfrentamientos y daños materiales. Una publicación en Facebook comparte dos imágenes del personaje: una en la que lanza un objeto en llamas y otra en la que hace una seña con los dedos medios de ambas manos, en medio de las protestas. La agencia AP publicó la versión original de la primera imagen. Según la descripción, muestra una protesta el 15 de diciembre de 2010 en Atenas, Grecia, en contra de medidas de [USN:H20101215 TEXT:"austeridad del gobierno"]. Reuters publicó la versión sin alterar de la segunda fotografía el 22 de junio de 2015 y dijo que corresponde a manifestaciones en Ereván, Armenia, en contra del aumento en los precios del servicio eléctrico . El usuario de Threads @aliframez publicó las imágenes el 8 de octubre, junto a otras 4 similares, con la etiqueta #PinkPantherEdit. Al 21 de octubre las imágenes ya no se encuentran disponibles. El usuario no comentó sobre las publicaciones. SynthID, herramienta de detección de IA de Google, determinó en un análisis que ambas imágenes fueron creadas utilizando uno de los modelos generativos de IA de la compañía tecnológica. La herramienta detecta todas o partes de marcas de agua imperceptibles que se encuentran presentes en los contenidos generados por los modelos de IA de Google. En respuesta a una solicitud de comentarios, Déborah Thiney-Masselin, portavoz de la Dirección General de la Policía Nacional de Francia, no comentó sobre la autenticidad de las fotos, pero dijo a Reuters en un correo el 20 de octubre que el uso del traje en las imágenes forma parte de una tendencia para superponer personajes de la cultura pop en medio de movimientos sociales. VEREDICTO Alteradas. Las imágenes fueron tomadas en protestas ocurridas en distintos años y diferentes lugares y fueron modificadas para añadir a un manifestante con el traje del personaje Pantera Rosa. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: STF exclui ISS de base de cálculo das contribuições federais, em vitória para empresas
item.description: O plenário do Supremo Tribunal Federal formou nesta quarta-feira maioria contrária à inclusão do ISS, o imposto municipal sobre serviços, da base de cálculo do PIS e da Cofins, contribuições federais criadas para financiar a seguridade social.
item.dc:creator: Ricardo Brito
item.content:encoded: O plenário do Supremo Tribunal Federal formou nesta quarta-feira maioria contrária à inclusão do ISS, o imposto municipal sobre serviços, da base de cálculo do PIS e da Cofins, contribuições federais criadas para financiar a seguridade social. O governo calcula que o impacto potencial da decisão desta quarta-feira é de R$34,5 bilhões. A decisão representa uma vitória para empresas que pleiteavam a retirada do ISS das contribuições federais e uma derrota para o governo federal, que estimava um impacto de dezenas de bilhões em caso de derrota. Empatado até então em cinco votos a cinco, o julgamento foi retomado nesta quarta-feira e contou com o voto decisivo do ministro Luiz Fux, que acompanhou o voto do ministro aposentado Celso de Mello e se manifestou a favor da tese das empresas. Fux chegou a propor uma modulação dos efeitos da decisão, mas os ministros decidiram aguardar a apresentação de eventuais embargos de declaração sobre os efeitos do julgamento. Procurada pela reportagem, a Procuradoria-Geral da Fazenda Nacional (PGFN) disse estar "analisando a decisão do Supremo Tribunal Federal para definir a estratégia de atuação". VITÓRIA A EMPRESAS O advogado tributarista Leonardo Roesler, sócio do RCA Advogados, disse que a decisão do STF recoloca um limite na relação entre arrecadação e atividade econômica, representando uma vitória a empresas prestadoras de serviços. "Agora, o alcance temporal do julgamento merece tanta atenção quanto a vitória de mérito. A recuperação de valores depende dos termos da decisão, de eventual modulação, da prescrição e da situação processual de cada contribuinte. Não se pode anunciar uma devolução automática dos últimos cinco anos para todas as empresas", disse. "É necessário examinar os recolhimentos, a documentação e os procedimentos cabíveis para restituição ou compensação, inclusive o trânsito em julgado quando exigido para compensar créditos reconhecidos judicialmente. A aplicação do precedente exige precisão quanto à tese fixada, aos regimes abrangidos e à comprovação contábil dos valores", explicou. Para a Flávio Molinari, sócio da área tributária do Collavini Borges Molinari Advogados, a decisão deve ser "festejada", principalmente levando em consideração que o STF já tinha decidido que o imposto estadual ICMS não compõe a base de cálculo da PIS e da Cofins, no chamado Tema 69, em 2017. Além disso, no início do mês, o tribunal também decidiu que [USN:L1N45T10Q TEXT:"créditos"] fiscais presumidos de ICMS não podem ser incluídos na base de cálculo de PIS/Cofins. "Evidentemente, tem um impacto orçamentário que provavelmente vai provocar um pedido de modulação de efeitos via embargos de declaração pela Procuradoria da Fazenda Nacional. E esse ponto vai inaugurar um novo capítulo ainda nessa discussão", afirmou Molinari.

item.title: EEUU se prepara para ordenar la salida de parte del personal de embajadas en el Golfo: fuentes
item.description: El Departamento de Estado se está preparando para ordenar la salida de parte de su personal y de los familiares de éstos de las embajadas estadounidenses en la región del Golfo, informaron el miércoles tres funcionarios de Estados Unidos.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Departamento de Estado se está preparando para ordenar la salida de parte de su personal y de los familiares de éstos de las embajadas estadounidenses en la región del Golfo, informaron el miércoles tres funcionarios de Estados Unidos. La medida responde a una posible reanudación de las hostilidades, en particular con la milicia hutí en Yemen, alineada con Irán, señalaron dos de los funcionarios estadounidenses. La Embajada de Estados Unidos en Riad emitió el miércoles una alerta de seguridad ante la posibilidad de nuevos ataques hutíes contra Arabia Saudita, tras recientes ofensivas mortales, incluidos ataques contra el aeropuerto de Riad. Dos de los funcionarios estadounidenses indicaron que las salidas ordenadas podrían conllevar la evacuación de todo el personal y sus familias de la misión diplomática de Estados Unidos en Arabia Saudita.

item.title: Papa León XIV no necesitará más tratamiento tras su operación, dicen médicos
item.description: El papa León XIV no necesitará más tratamiento tras someterse a una intervención quirúrgica por cáncer de pulmón la semana pasada, indicaron sus médicos en un comunicado difundido por el Vaticano el miércoles en el que señalaron que el tumor no se había extendido.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El papa León XIV no necesitará más tratamiento tras someterse a una intervención quirúrgica por cáncer de pulmón la semana pasada, indicaron sus médicos en un comunicado difundido por el Vaticano el miércoles en el que señalaron que el tumor no se había extendido. El anuncio se produjo cuando aún no estaba claro si el pontífice seguiría adelante con el viaje previsto a Uruguay, Argentina y Perú, del 6 al 17 de noviembre. Al papa, de 71 años, se le extirpó el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho en una intervención quirúrgica el 13 de octubre y se le diagnosticó un adenocarcinoma de pulmón, el tipo más común de cáncer de pulmón. Los resultados de los exámenes histológicos confirmaron el diagnóstico, y la enfermedad sigue estando localizada, según los médicos. "Una evaluación oncológica posterior ha confirmado que no se requiere ningún tratamiento adicional", dijeron el cirujano jefe del papa, Stefano Margaritora, y su médico personal, Luigi Carbone. León recibió el alta el sábado y está retomando gradualmente sus funciones habituales. El miércoles regresó a la Plaza de San Pedro para su audiencia semanal con los fieles. Margaritora afirmó la semana pasada que no había "razones clínicas" que impidieran al papa viajar a Sudamérica, pero el secretario de Estado del Vaticano ha dicho que el pontífice podría tener que ajustar el ritmo de su agenda para facilitar su recuperación.

item.title: Jansen’s all-round heroics put South Africa on brink of series-levelling win
item.description: Everything went South Africa’s way on the fourth day of the second test against Australia at St George’s Park on Wednesday, but a positive mental approach was also key, fast bowler Marco Jansen said after a dream outing for him and his teammates.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Everything went South Africa’s way on the fourth day of the second test against Australia at St George’s Park on Wednesday, but a positive mental approach was also key, fast bowler Marco Jansen said after a dream outing for him and his teammates. The 26-year-old has been a central figure in South Africa’s revival as they clawed their way back from 110-6 after two rain-affected days to build a 326-run first-innings lead over the tourists. Jansen scored 85 runs on Tuesday in his second-highest test score and followed that up on Wednesday with 5-33 in 11 overs to help dismiss Australia for 99 and force them to follow on. “With the two days of rain we had to try and bowl them out as quickly as possible, and I’m just very, very happy the way it turned out and just happy that we could capitalise on the wickets and the new ball,” Jansen told reporters. “I thought the guys bowled really, really well with a lot of intent and energy. But it’s one thing to bowl well, but it's another thing to be backed up by your fielders as well. They took some stunning catches with just everything, basically, going our way.” Jansen said his batting and bowling had much to do with a strong belief in his ability. MENTAL APPROACH “For me personally, it's all about the mental approach. I'm not technically the most sound or beautiful-looking batter, but I like to think from a personal perspective, I can trust my hands. “I know that I can, if just from a mental point of view, think in a positive way, then I'm already giving myself the best chance to execute whatever shot I’m trying to play. "In the past, there was a bit of doubt in terms of the way I wanted to go about it, and I went through a bit of ebb and flow when it comes to that. And also playing innings like that, you need a bit of luck now and then.” Jansen said bowling conditions were better than in Durban, where South Africa were handed a 214-run defeat in the opening test. “The ball got a bit more bounce and a bit more seam, and fortunately for me, it just got the edge. We bowled in better areas for longer periods and stuck at what we thought was going to work at this wicket,” he added. "Test cricket is all about resilience coupled with consistency." South Africa need six wickets on Thursday to win and level the series, with Australia 156-4 in their second innings and still 170 runs adrift.

item.title: Kurt Suzuki out as Angels manager as new era begins to takes shape
item.description: The Los Angeles Angels began their offseason of expected upheaval Wednesday by announcing that Kurt Suzuki will not return as manager in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Los Angeles Angels began their offseason of expected upheaval Wednesday by announcing that Kurt Suzuki will not return as manager in 2027. In his first season at the helm of the Angels, Suzuki guided the team to a 62-100 record, leaving the franchise with its first 100-loss season in its 65-year history. Suzuki, 43, was only signed to a one-year contract with an option for 2027 when he took the job. He offered a spot to remain within the franchise as a special assistant. The announcement was made by Angels baseball operations consultant John Mozeliak, who took over daily operations of the club when general manager Perry Minasian was fired in June. "Kurt has earned tremendous respect in our clubhouse, and I've seen firsthand how much he cares about our players," Mozeliak said in a statement. "I do not believe our record this year was a true reflection of his abilities as a manager. I'm pleased we were able to offer Kurt a role to stay on as a special assistant, where his knowledge of our players and his perspective would continue to be valuable to the organization." After attending Cal State Fullerton, a short drive from Angel Stadium, Suzuki batted .255 with 143 home runs and 730 RBIs over 1,635 games and 16 seasons for five different clubs, including seven seasons with the Athletics and two with the Angels. He was an All-Star for the Minnesota Twins in 2014. The franchise currently is undergoing an ownership change after Arte Moreno sold the club for a reported $4 billion to Kroenke Sports & Entertainment, which also owns the NFL's Los Angeles Rams, the NBA's Denver Nuggets, the NHL's Colorado Avalanche and the MLS's Colorado Rapids, among other sports holdings. The sale was agreed to in September but is not expected to become official until the first quarter of 2027. Mozeliak said that some members of the coaching staff were offered positions to remain in the organization but did not reveal any specifics. --Field Level Media

item.title: Pope Leo will not need further cancer treatment, doctors say
item.description: Pope Leo will not need any further therapy after undergoing lung cancer surgery last week, his doctors said on Wednesday, indicating that his tumor had not spread.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pope Leo will not need any further therapy after undergoing lung cancer surgery last week, his doctors said on Wednesday, indicating that his tumor had not spread. The announcement came as it was still unclear whether the US-born pope would proceed with a planned trip to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, scheduled for November 6-17. The 71-year-old pontiff had the lower lobe of his right lung removed in surgery on [USN:L1N45Z08S TEXT:"October 13"] and was diagnosed with [USN:L8N46006S TEXT:"lung adenocarcinoma"], the most common form of lung cancer. Final histological examinations and molecular biology analyses of the tissue removed confirmed the diagnosis, with the disease remaining localized, the doctors said in a statement released by the Vatican. "A subsequent oncological evaluation has confirmed that no further therapy is required," the pope's lead surgeon, Stefano Margaritora, and his personal physician, Luigi Carbone, said. Leo was [USN:L1N46302W TEXT:"discharged from hospital"] on Saturday and is gradually resuming his normal duties. On Wednesday, he [USN:L8N4670GR TEXT:"returned"] to St Peter's Square for his weekly audience with pilgrims. Margaritora said last week there were "no clinical reasons" preventing the pope from travelling to South America, but the Vatican's secretary of state has indicated the pontiff may need to adjust the pace of his schedule to aid his recovery.

item.title: Vídeo de dinheiro apreendido não tem relação com suposta compra de votos para Lula
item.description: Um vídeo de uma apreensão de dinheiro vivo mostra uma operação contra fraudes fiscais, e não uma ação contra um suposto esquema de compra de votos para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT).
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Um vídeo de uma apreensão de dinheiro vivo mostra uma operação contra fraudes fiscais, e não uma ação contra um suposto esquema de compra de votos para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Estes são os principais detalhes: "PRF prende mais de seis milhões que estavam sendo direcionados para compra de voto para eleger Lula no segundo turno e pagar traficantes para oprimir as pessoas", dizem as publicações, que circulam no Facebook e no Instagram. O texto circula junto a um vídeo que mostra agentes de segurança contando uma grande quantidade de dinheiro. Porém, as imagens são de uma das ações da operação Dionísio , coordenada pelo Ministério Público de Alagoas (MP-AL) em parceria com outros órgãos, que investigava um esquema de sonegação fiscal. O vídeo foi publicado originalmente no perfil do MP-AL no Instagram em 24 de setembro, antes do primeiro turno das eleições deste ano, realizado em 4 de outubro. A Polícia Rodoviária Federal (PRF) disse à Reuters que o vídeo não é de uma apreensão realizada pela instituição. Veredicto: Falso. O vídeo mostra uma investigação do MP-AL de combate à sonegação fiscal, e não uma ação da PRF contra uma suposta compra de votos para beneficiar Lula. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
３営業日ぶりに反発して取引を終えた。石油株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に反発した。中型株で...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（21日） 4:07 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

３営業日ぶりに反発して取引を終えた。石油株が買われ、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に反発した。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．３１％高だった。

石油大手のＢＰは１．９％、シェルは０．２％それぞれ上昇。北海のジャックドー・ガス田の採掘を英政府が承認した。

資産運用会社アバディーンは４．１％安。一部で資金流入の回復が予想より遅れるとの見通しを示し、売られた。上半期決算を発表した自転車・自動車部品販売のハルフォーズは８．６％安。

９月の英消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）上昇率は前年同月比３．５％と、伸び率が前月から加速。市場予想３．４％を上回った。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、市場ではイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が１１月に０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めることがほぼ確実視されている。

ヒーリー財務相の予算案発表を来週に控える中、公的部門の純借入額は２カ月連続で市場予想を上回った。公的債務残高は３兆ポンド（約４兆１００億ドル）を超えた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反発して取引を終えた。堅調な業績を示した企業が物色される中、抗議デモ激化に伴う政治不安から下落していたフランスのＣＡＣ４０指数は１．０６％高と買い戻しの動きが出た。

オランダの人材サービス大手ランスタッドは２０．２％高。直近四半期決算が好感された。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は１．７２％高。フランスの高級眼鏡大手エシロールルックスオティカは１５．５％上昇。

増収決算となったデンマークの物流大手ＤＳＶは１５．１％上昇した。

一方、ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種自動車・部品株指数は１．７２％安。フランスの大手タイヤメーカー、ミシュランは７．２％下落した。

フランスの小売大手カルフールは１３．８％安。暴動や略奪、夜間外出禁止令による影響を踏まえて通期業績予想を下方修正し、値下がりした。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが上昇した。フランスで抗議行動が広がり、ぜい弱な財政と政治的不透明感への懸念が一段と強まった。

フランスの指標となる１０年物国債（ＯＡＴ）利回りは、２００２年７月以来初めて５％台に乗せた。この日は８ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）、今週では２０ｂｐ超上昇した。

独仏１０年債利回り格差＜DE１０FR１０=RR＞は１５０ｂｐと、ユーロ圏主要国債市場で最大となった。１０月初めに付けた約１６０ｂｐの１５年ぶり高水準に向けて再び拡大しつつある。

フランスの混乱は２０日までにいくぶん落ち着いたが、２４日にはさらなる抗議行動が予定されており、企業は財務面での打撃を感じ始めている。

投資家はイタリアにも注目している。生活費高騰を巡る抗議行動を受け、メローニ首相は２０日、より厳しい暴動対策を承認した。

ただイタリア国債は今週、フランス債よりも堅調で、１０年利回りの上昇は１２ｂｐにとどまった。

イタリア１０年債利回りは８ｂｐ上昇し４．６０４７％となった。独伊１０年債利回り格差は４ｂｐ拡大して１１６ｂｐとなった。

ドイツの１０年債利回りは３．４ｂｐ上昇の３．４２７４％と、今週はほぼ変わらず。２年債利回りは４ｂｐ上昇し３．０９４０％となった。
