item.title: Bob Uecker family salutes Brewers: 'He’s right here cheering alongside us'
item.description: MILWAUKEE -- The Brewers' first World Series appearance in 44 years has arrived too late for beloved broadcaster Bob Uecker to enjoy, although the former player's family said the current playoff run has kept his spirit alive.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: MILWAUKEE -- The Brewers' first World Series appearance in 44 years has arrived too late for beloved broadcaster Bob Uecker to enjoy, although the former player's family said the current playoff run has kept his spirit alive. Uecker, who played from 1962-67 and was a Hall of Fame broadcaster for the Brewers, passed away on Jan. 16, 2025. "We are filled with elation and pride, but also longing. A wish that Bob was here to see it, too," the Uecker family said in a statement released Wednesday. "While we could never speak for him, this is certain: Milwaukee, the Brewers, and the fans meant everything to Bob. Wherever we gather -- in a packed stadium, a neighborhood bar, or a living room with the radio turned all the way up -- we know he's right here cheering alongside us." The Brewers are set to play host to Game 1 of the World Series on Friday against the Tampa Bay Rays. The franchise's only other World Series appearance came in 1982 when Milwaukee fell to the St. Louis Cardinals as a representative of the American League. "To the players -- You believed in each other and the power of friendship," the statement read. "You carried the city with you every time you took the field, making memories that will last a lifetime. Bob would have been so incredibly proud of what you've accomplished." But while earning their spot in the World Series last week with a National League Championship Series sweep of the two-time defending champion Los Angeles Dodgers, Milwaukee manager Pat Murphy took a moment to remember the beloved longtime voice of the franchise. "He'd be so happy for the guys," Murphy said of Uecker during the celebration following the NLCS victory. "Those who knew him well are all thinking about Ueck today." After batting .200 over six seasons and 297 games for the Milwaukee Braves, Philadelphia Phillies and Cardinals, Uecker's fame grew as a funnyman with appearances alongside Johnny Carson on the "Tonight Show" and in the "Major League" movie franchise. Uecker called Brewers games for 54 seasons and was named the recipient of the Hall of Fame's Ford C. Frick Award in 2003. --Field Level Media

item.title: Trump's MAGA Inc unleashes $277 million last-ditch effort to save Republicans in key US races
item.description: President Donald Trump has unleashed more than $277 million in a last-minute TV and direct mail advertising blitz over the final six weeks of the midterm campaign to help struggling Republican candidates in several races that are key to the party's chances to retain control of the US Congress.
item.dc:creator: Virginia Furness
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump has unleashed more than $277 million in a last-minute TV and direct mail advertising blitz over the final six weeks of the midterm campaign to help struggling Republican candidates in several races that are key to the party's chances to retain control of the US Congress. Trump's MAGA Inc super PAC, which has spent over $300 million on the midterms so far, poured the most money directly or through other PACs into the Texas, Michigan and Ohio Senate races where the Republican candidates are in tight races and trailing Democratic challengers in most polls, Federal Election Commission data shows. [USN:FWN4661SF TEXT:"Trump said on Truth Social"] that he planned to spend $400 million to $500 million by election day, now less than two weeks away. He channeled $225 million of the recent spending through two other super PACs, No Going Back and Safety & Affordability, the filings show. Super PACs can accept and spend unlimited amounts on campaigns with few restrictions. Together, the PACs have spent more than $36 million on the [USN:L6N4660XW TEXT:"Texas Senate race"] for Ken Paxton, $30.1 million to help Mike Rogers in Michigan, and over [USN:L6N45U0XV TEXT:"$28 million supporting Jon Husted in Ohio"]. The [USN:L6N45U0XV TEXT:"three seats are key"] to Republicans retaining control of the Senate where the party has a 53-47 majority. Democrats need to pick up at least four seats in November's midterm elections to win control of the 100-seat US Senate. Their chances have improved as sky-high fuel prices, ICE raids and the Iran war have driven Trump's popularity to historic lows. Election forecaster Nate Silver's latest data places the Democrats' chances of taking the Senate at over 77% with a 53-47 majority and the House at more than 94% with a 240-195 majority. [USN:L6N45Y0SX TEXT:"Elon Musk"] has joined Trump in pouring money into his new home state of Texas, where Musk moved Tesla and SpaceX's headquarters in recent years. MAGA Inc waited until the last few weeks to ramp up advertising, causing angst among Republican leaders. Republican mega donors turned out for Trump last month. Hotel and casino mogul Stephen Wynn donated $8 million, Blackstone CEO Stephen Schwarzman and businesswoman Diane Hendricks gave $5 million apiece in September alone. Australian crypto billionaire Bijan Tehrani and Russian-born businessman Konstanin Sokolov each donated $1 million last month, the filings show. Hendricks has given $30 million to MAGA Inc so far this year, while Tehrani and Sokolov have donated $2 million each, according to the filings. The super PAC still had $164 million in available cash as of last week. It has raised roughly $450 million this campaign cycle.

item.title: What counts as consent? Third-party releases in the wake of Purdue
item.description: BCLP partner Justin Winerman examines the different approaches courts are taking to define consent for third-party releases in Chapter 11 plans following the Supreme Court's ruling in Purdue.
item.dc:creator: Justin Winerman
item.content:encoded: Nonconsensual third-party releases are not permissible under a chapter 11 plan. Courts are now left to work out what "consent" actually means. In 2024, the U.S. Supreme Court in Harrington v. Purdue Pharma L.P., 603 U.S. 204 (2024)(hereinafter, "Purdue"), held that the Bankruptcy Code did not provide a statutory basis for nonconsensual third-party releases to be approved under a chapter 11 plan. The Court, however, did not prohibit consensual third-party releases, nor did it decide what constitutes consent. "Nothing in what we have said should be construed to call into question consensual third-party releases offered in connection with a bankruptcy reorganization plan. ... Nor do we have occasion today to express a view on what qualifies as a consensual release." Since Purdue, courtrooms across the country have grappled with what constitutes consent, with varying — and evolving — results. Essentially, the debate turns on whether a court requires creditors to affirmatively opt into granting a third-party release (e.g., by checking a box to opt in) before they are bound by it, or requires creditors to opt out if they do not want to be bound. At times, that may depend on whether the court looks to state or federal law. Some courts hold that opt-out releases are valid as long as there is clear and conspicuous notice. Others say the permissibility of opt-out releases depends on whether the parties granting such releases are entitled to vote and/or will receive any recovery under the proposed plan. Still others require parties to opt in to manifest consent to third-party releases. This article examines some of the approaches taken by various courts in the wake of Purdue and offers practical takeaways depending on the facts of a particular case. Opt-out third-party releases: Permitted with clear and conspicuous notice Post-Purdue, some courts have permitted use of an opt-out mechanism to bind parties to third-party releases. Typically, these courts require clear and conspicuous notice of the release, the opt-out procedures, and the consequences of not opting out. For example, in a 2025 decision in Spirit Airlines' first bankruptcy case, Southern District of New York bankruptcy judge Sean Lane applied federal bankruptcy law and approved an opt-out mechanism for third-party releases. He allowed them in large part due to the clear and prominent notice and explanation of the third-party releases provided to those deemed to consent, including in the ballots and the opt-out form. See In re Spirit Airlines, Inc., 668 B.R. 689, 707-08 (Bankr. S.D.N.Y. 2025). Moreover, there was a clear procedure for opting out, the parties discussed the third-party releases throughout the case (which was well-publicized), the creditors had a clear economic incentive to pay attention to the bankruptcy case given they were promised a full or substantial recovery, and the only impaired class consisted of parties to a restructuring support agreement that overwhelmingly supported the plan. The court, therefore, held that the opt-out procedure was valid even with respect to non-voting and abstaining creditors. Judge Lane again approved an opt-out mechanism in In re Azul S.A., 676 B.R. 277 (Bankr. S.D.N.Y. 2026), finding the result would be the same either under federal or state law. Before Judge Lane's decision, the Debtors in Azul had made the opt-out mechanism only applicable to creditors that voted on the plan. Importantly, the decision came after the District Court for the Southern District of New York rejected an opt-out mechanism in another airline case weeks earlier (described below). Hybrid approach: Opt-out for some, opt-in for others Other courts have permitted opt-out mechanisms as constituting consent to third-party releases, but only for certain parties. Creditors who reject the plan For example, in In re Pat McGrath Cosms. LLC, 679 B.R. 591, 601-02 (Bankr. S.D. Fla. 2026), the bankruptcy court, applying federal law, permitted an opt-out mechanism. But under her so-called hybrid approach, Judge Isicoff found the opt-out mechanism was not proper for creditors who rejected the plan or had a claim or interest that was deemed to reject the plan. Non-voting parties and parties recovering little or nothing Even before Purdue, the Fifth Circuit did not permit nonconsensual third-party releases under a plan, giving courts in that Circuit prior experience with determining what constitutes consent. After Purdue, in In re Container Store Grp., Inc., 676 B.R. 356 (S.D. Tex. 2026), the Southern District of Texas District Court, applying federal law, affirmed the opt-out releases approved by the bankruptcy court in part. But the District Court held the bankruptcy court erred in finding that subordinated claim holders and equity holders, who were receiving nothing under the plan (and were deemed to reject the plan), consented. The ruling is currently on appeal to the Fifth Circuit. In the wake of the District Court's ruling, some bankruptcy courts in the Southern District of Texas continue to approve opt-out mechanics but, in some cases, courts have required that nonvoting classes and/or classes not receiving any recovery are carved out of the releases, in accordance with the Container Store District Court opinion. For example, in Luminar, the debtors amended the plan to remove classes of creditors and equity holders who were not receiving any recovery and were deemed to reject the plan from the opt-out. See In re Luminar Technologies, Inc., Case No. 25-90807, Docket Nos. 558 and 581 (Bankr. S.D. Tex. Mar. 30, 2026). Similarly, in Office Properties and Cumulus Media, the judges approved opt-outs for certain parties, but required others (e.g., holders of equity interests) to affirmatively opt in. See In re Office Properties Income Trust, Case No. 25-90530, Docket Nos. 1223 and 1241 (Bankr. S.D. Tex. Apr. 22, 2026); In re Cumulus Media Inc., Case No. 26-90346, Docket Nos. 225 and 243 (Bankr. S.D. Tex. Apr. 15, 2026). In addition, some courts require that parties who abstain (do not vote to accept or reject) are not bound by the third-party releases, unless they separately opt-in. See, e.g., In re Del Monte Foods Corporation, Inc., Case No. 25-16984, Docket No. 1592 (Bankr. D.N.J. May 22, 2026). Does silence equal consent? Some courts have said that consent generally requires an affirmative opt-in. Judge Cote took this approach in In re GOL Linhas Aereas Inteligentes S.A., 675 B.R. 125, 131 (S.D.N.Y. 2025), in the Southern District of New York: "[T]he general principles of contract law, as embodied in the Restatement of Contracts, establish that, outside of rare exceptions, consent cannot be implied from silence." Judge Cote said that regardless of whether federal or state law applied, opt-out releases were not sufficient to establish consent. In the Buffalo Diocese bankruptcy case, after nearly six years of fighting, the debtor Diocese and the creditors' committee, who represented abuse victims, agreed to a deal where participating parties and settling insurers agreed to make substantial contributions. These contributions, totaling more than $280 million, when combined with the Debtor's contribution meant that abuse claimants were going to receive recoveries from a settlement trust funded in excess of $300 million. Third-party releases and injunctions, however, were critical to the non-debtor contributing parties' willingness to fund the contributions. As such, the Diocese and the Creditors' Committee advocated for an opt-out release mechanism. But the United States Trustee objected and the bankruptcy court agreed, relying on state law: "The longstanding rule in New York is that silence does not constitute consent, except in instances where estoppel might apply." In re Diocese of Buffalo, N.Y., 677 B.R. 663, 666 (Bankr. W.D.N.Y. 2026), reconsideration denied, motion to certify granted, 678 B.R. 471 (Bankr. W.D.N.Y. 2026). Nonetheless, in the Buffalo Diocese case, the Diocese identified a need to resolve claims being asserted not only against the Debtor, but also against affiliated entities, such as the parishes. The bankruptcy court, therefore, agreed to enter a case management order setting guidelines for the use of rapid prepackaged bankruptcy cases that the parishes and affiliated entities of the Diocese could use. A similar approach was taken in the Diocese of Rockville Centre bankruptcy case and is being sought in the Diocese of Ogdensburg. At the same time, the underlying decision on opt-out releases in the Buffalo Diocese case was certified for direct appeal to the Second Circuit, where it joins the Gol ruling, also under appeal at the Second Circuit. Practical takeaways There is no one-size-fits-all strategy. Different judges and different facts can lead to different law. Therefore, it's critical to know your case (including what type of case it is, whether a prepackaged case, a mass tort case, a liquidating case, or something else), your facts (e.g. are creditors incentivized to pay attention, is the case well-publicized, are creditors incented to follow the case, what are they receiving, etc.), your judge, and the law. In all cases, clear and conspicuous language explaining the releases being sought, the procedures for obtaining them, and the impact of consenting to them along with sufficient notice and due process are critical. This is true regardless of whether such releases are sought to be obtained by an opt-in or opt-out mechanism. If courts require an opt-in mechanism, in cases where third-party releases are necessary to implement a transaction, and there is uncertainty about parties opting in, parties and their counsel should consider other options for obtaining third-party releases, including potentially filing for chapter 15 (where nonconsensual releases remain available). In addition, parties should be open to opportunities to achieve substantially similar certainty, via other alternatives, including: •A 363 sale (with an insurance policy buyback) •Rapid prepackaged bankruptcy cases so that entities can file bankruptcy and obtain the benefit of the discharge and related injunction •Relying on debtor releases of estate causes of action, which can include a release of derivative claim •Requiring individual claimant releases to entitle such claimant to receive a distribution •Section 524(g) channeling injunctions (where available) •Exculpation •Gatekeeping injunctions The author would like to thank associate Daniel Reynolds for contributing to this article.

Oct 21 : Como's Nico Paz tormented Manchester United with two goals and an assist as the Italian side swept to a 4-1 Champions League victory on Wednesday, while Galatasaray won a six-goal thriller at Lille. Paz put Como ahead inside two minutes with a curling effort from the edge of the box, setting the tone for a miserable night for United in northern Italy. The Argentine helped double the lead four minutes after halftime, threading a perfectly weighted ball through the defence after a slick exchange of passes. Anastasios Douvikas beat the offside trap and finished first time past the advancing goalkeeper. Paz then robbed Carlos Baleba near the right touchline and surged diagonally for more than 30 metres, bursting into the box before steering a left-footed finish inside the far post.

Como added a fourth in the 76th minute when substitute Kaiki Bruno raced down the left and crossed for centre back Jacobo Ramon to head past Senne Lammens. Joshua Zirkzee grabbed United's stoppage-time consolation from Amad Diallo's cross. In France, Galatasaray beat Lille 4-2 after twice surrendering the initiative. Yunus Akgun fired the visitors ahead shortly after kickoff, but Soriba Diaoune equalised five minutes later and struck again in the 39th minute to put Lille in front. Alexey Batrakov headed Galatasaray level in the 44th minute before Lucas Torreira appeared to glance home a corner in the 52nd, although the effort was later credited as an own goal for Nabil Bentaleb. Victor Osimhen completed the scoring nine minutes later with a powerful strike from the edge of the box.

item.title: 米メタに250億ドル支払い命令、ＦＢ個人情報問題で利用者欺いたと陪審認定
item.description:
Diana Novak Jones
[２１日 ロイター] - 米ニューメキシコ州の判事は２１日、米メタ・プラットフォ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米メタに250億ドル支払い命令、ＦＢ個人情報問題で利用者欺いたと陪審認定 4:00 配信

１０月１９日撮影　REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Diana Novak Jones

[２１日 ロイター] - 米ニューメキシコ州の判事は２１日、米メタ・プラットフォームズに対し２５０億ドルの支払いを命じた。トランプ氏の２０１６年米大統領選陣営に関与した政治コンサルティング会社がフェイスブック利用者数百万人のデータを本人の同意なく取得したとされる問題を巡る訴訟で、陪審がメタは利用者を欺いていたと認定したことを受けた。

フランシス・マシュー判事は、この件は「フェイスブックの中核的な事業慣行そのものに関わる問題だ」と指摘。州法に基づけば２１９０億ドル超の制裁金が妥当となるが、最終的に２５０億ドルに減額した。

メタの広報担当者からコメントは得られていない。

この件を巡っては、英政治コンサルティング会社ケンブリッジ・アナリティカがサードパーティー製アプリを通じて最大８７００万人分のフェイスブック利用者の個人データを収集していたことが明らかになり、ニューメキシコ州の司法長官が２０２１年にメタを提訴していた。

item.title: US orders departure of diplomats from Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes
item.description: The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and is planning to move out family members from a number of other US missions in the Gulf, US officials told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and is planning to move out family members from a number of other US missions in the Gulf, US officials told Reuters. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a post on X that the department ordered the departure of "non-emergency US government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only" amid attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis in Yemen on civilian targets in the country. Washington had returned some diplomatic personnel to the region in recent months after many were pulled out when Tehran launched retaliatory attacks on US facilities after the US-Israeli war on Iran began in late February. "Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions," Pigott said. Four US officials told Reuters that US missions in other Gulf states would also be ordering family members to leave. Pigott did not address changes to other missions outside Saudi Arabia. The US embassy in Riyadh issued a security alert on Wednesday about possible further attacks by the Houthis on Saudi Arabia, after recent deadly strikes including [USN:S8N43T03L TEXT:"on Riyadh's airport"].

item.title: ゼレンスキー氏、米ロとの3者協議再開支持 11月上旬までの開催希望
item.description: [２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２１日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２１日、ロシア、米国、ウクライナの実務レベル協議を早期に開催するとの米国の提案を支持すると表明した。

ゼレンスキー大統領は記者団に対し、協議は遅くとも１１月上旬までの実施が望ましいとし、和平案のほか、首脳レベルの会談の可能性について取り上げられるとの見方を示した。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使はゼレンスキー氏と２０日にノルウェーの首都オスロで会談した後、２１日にロシアのプーチン大統領とロシア第２の都市サンクトペテルブルクで会談。ウィットコフ氏との会談を受け、プーチン大統領はウクライナ和平に向けた米国仲介の協議の再開に合意した。

ゼレンスキー氏はノルウェーから首都キーウへの帰途、記者団に対し、ウィットコフ氏がプーチン大統領と会談した後、米政府当局者と協議したと明らかにし、「ロシアが実務レベルの３者協議を支持しているとの説明を受けた。米国は可能な限り早期の開催を提案しており、ウクライナも支持している。ウクライナは米国と連絡を取り合っており、米国は協議を１１月中、できれば１１月上旬までに実施できるよう全力を尽くすと考えている」と語った。

その上で、ウクライナは「停戦、戦争終結、エネルギー施設を対象とした停戦、人道的取り組みなど、いかなる提案も支持する」と述べた。

ロシア大統領府によると、３者協議の開催地としてアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビが検討されており、１１月１０日、もしくはそれ以降に実施される可能性がある。

item.title: Congreso peruano otorga a Gobierno poderes para dictar leyes contra crimen y El Niño
item.description: El Congreso peruano aprobó el miércoles otorgar al Gobierno de la presidenta Keiko Fujimori, por un plazo de 90 días, poderes legislativos para que pueda dictar leyes contra el crimen -como la participación de las Fuerzas Armadas en la seguridad interna- y para prevenir los efectos del fenómeno climático de El Niño.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Congreso peruano aprobó el miércoles otorgar al Gobierno de la presidenta Keiko Fujimori, por un plazo de 90 días, poderes legislativos para que pueda dictar leyes contra el crimen -como la participación de las Fuerzas Armadas en la seguridad interna- y para prevenir los efectos del fenómeno climático de El Niño. La decisión, aprobada por 35 votos a favor, 18 en contra y seis abstenciones en el Senado, da luz verde a Fujimori para emitir leyes sin necesidad de pasar por el Congreso en materias como la participación "temporal y excepcional" de las Fuerzas Armadas en la seguridad interna, en apoyo a la policía nacional. Asimismo, el gobierno podrá dictar decretos para agilizar la ayuda humanitaria, apoyar a los agricultores y facilitar las obras de prevención y recuperación de servicios básicos frente al fenómeno de El Niño, que según organismos del clima se manifestará desde noviembre [USN:L1N4620VD TEXT:"como el más poderoso"] en décadas. El Congreso aprobó un conjunto de 27 iniciativas de leyes, menos que la propuesta oficial de un paquete de 66 medidas -que fueron depuradas por la Cámara de Diputados-.

Oct 21 : Electronic Arts is planning to close BioWare, the developer of the "Mass Effect" series of games, and lay off employees to focus on more lucrative projects, the company said on Wednesday in an email to employees. Here are some details: • EA said it would cancel an early-stage "Mass Effect" project and close BioWare's studio in Edmonton, Canada, marking the end of the developer known for role-playing game franchises such as "Dragon Age" • EA is planning to cut around 400 jobs, about 3 per cent of its total staff, including roughly 50 at BioWare, Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday, citing a person familiar with the company’s plans

item.title: Grupo México se baja de licitación de tren Belgrano Cargas en Argentina
item.description: El Grupo México Transportes (GMXT) decidió no avanzar en el proceso de licitación para privatizar la empresa argentina Belgrano Cargas y Logística (BCYL), informó el miércoles un portavoz de la empresa.
item.dc:creator: Lucila Sigal
item.content:encoded: El Grupo México Transportes (GMXT) (GMEXICOB.MX) decidió no avanzar en el proceso de licitación para privatizar la empresa argentina Belgrano Cargas y Logística (BCYL), informó el miércoles un portavoz de la empresa. El conglomerado mexicano, controlado por el multimillonario Germán Larrea, se había convertido en uno de los contendientes más fuertes para el Belgrano Cargas, que opera las tres mayores líneas de trenes de cargas de Argentina, que conectan zonas de producción agrícola y minera con los puertos de exportación. Una fuente con conocimiento del tema dijo a Reuters que la empresa decidió bajarse de la contienda al encontrar que no estaban las condiciones dadas para avanzar y advertir la necesidad de mayores precisiones respecto de ciertos aspectos técnicos en los que aún había incertidumbre. La [USN:L1N3WP0SE TEXT:"privatización"] de la red forma parte del plan del presidente ultraliberal Javier Milei para transferir empresas estatales con dificultades a manos privadas y atraer inversiones para sus reservas tras años de crisis económicas. El gobierno sostiene que el sistema sufrió décadas de falta de inversión y que privatizará los trenes bajo un modelo de "acceso abierto" para fomentar la competencia, con operadores privados gestionando la infraestructura y permitiendo que múltiples empresas de transporte de mercancías usen las vías. Esta estructura parecía ser un punto conflictivo para Grupo México, ya que la empresa había dicho en julio que solo estaba dispuesta a avanzar en el proceso si podía tener el control total tanto de la infraestructura como de las operaciones. Según medios argentinos, [USN:L1N42J0N1 TEXT:"Grupo México"] había manifestado un gran interés en la privatización, que incluía una alianza con la empresa estadounidense de tecnología ferroviaria Wabtec y una inversión propuesta de hasta 3.000 millones de dólares para modernizar la red. Argentina es el principal exportador mundial de aceite y harina de soja y el tercero de maíz, y está intentando expandir sus exportaciones de energía y minería. Menos del 5% de la carga del país se transporta por ferrocarril, lo que obliga de depender en gran medida de los camiones y eleva el costo del transporte de cosechas y minerales hacia el puerto. Belgrano Cargas controla las líneas Urquiza, Belgrano y San Martín, que tienen una extensión total de 7.594 kilómetros que impactan en la economía de 15 provincias del centro y norte del país, el corazón productivo del agro y de los principales proyectos mineros de oro, plata, cobre y litio. También había manifestado interés en la licitación un consorcio agrícola integrado por Bunge Global, Cargill Inc., Louis Dreyfus Co., Asociación de Cooperativas Argentinas y Aceitera General Deheza SA.

item.title: IMF urges exchange rate flexibility as RBI steps up rupee defence
item.description: The IMF urged Asian economies to allow exchange rates to absorb global shocks as the RBI steps up efforts to support the rupee amid oil price pressures and foreign outflows ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Foreign-exchange intervention offers limited benefits beyond the near term and currencies should be allowed to adjust to global shocks, a top International Monetary Fund official said. “Countries which allow exchange rates to move have benefited more,” Krishna Srinivasan, director of the IMF’s Asia and Pacific Department, said at a press conference in Mumbai on Wednesday, responding to a question about Asian currencies. With economies facing a succession of global shocks, exchange rates should be allowed to absorb some of the pressure and act as the “first line of defense,” he said, without naming the Reserve Bank of India. Central banks across Asia are grappling with currency weakness as global shocks drive capital outflows and boost demand for dollars. Policymakers from Indonesia to Japan have deployed a mix of interest-rate increases and market intervention, testing how far authorities can resist depreciation without running down reserves or imposing greater costs on their economies. In India, the RBI is mounting its most forceful defense of the rupee since the 2013 taper tantrum. The currency has been among Asia’s worst performers this year, pressured by elevated oil prices and persistent foreign outflows from Indian stocks. The RBI this month rolled out a special window to meet dollar demand from state-run oil companies and a new tool requiring banks to park cash against certain foreign-exchange transactions. The moves followed its first interest-rate increase in nearly four years, as policymakers confront the risk that a weaker rupee and elevated crude could further stoke inflation. The IMF drew a distinction, however, between intervening in the currency market and measures designed to attract capital. Ranil Salgado, its senior resident representative for India, Bhutan and Maldives, described recent RBI steps to ease foreign inflows as broadly positive. “We think that is a good policy,” he said. The central bank has sought to bolster dollar supplies by easing rules for foreign borrowing and offering incentives to attract foreign-currency deposits from overseas Indians. Those measures have brought in billions of dollars, helping cushion pressure on the rupee without relying solely on the RBI’s reserves. Salgado also noted that the RBI’s stated policy is to curb excessive currency volatility rather than defend a particular exchange-rate level.

Oct 21 : Paris St Germain's Ligue 1 match against Olympique Lyonnais on Sunday could be postponed after the Paris police prefecture raised security concerns amid ongoing nationwide unrest, French media reported on Wednesday. According to the reports, the police prefecture has asked the French Professional Football League (LFP) to reschedule the fixture, which is due to be played in Paris on Sunday. Sports daily L'Equipe reported that the match could be moved to Monday, although no official decision has been announced. French officials will mount a "massive" security operation for protests planned on Saturday, with troops reinforcing police, Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said on Tuesday, after rioting and looting swept through Paris and other French cities on October 17.

item.title: New Mexico sues Jeffrey Epstein's former lawyer and accountant
item.description: New Mexico has filed a civil lawsuit against the former lawyer and accountant of Jeffrey Epstein to block payments by the late sex offender's estate and recover damages for survivors of his alleged sexual abuse, the state's top law enforcement official said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Hay
item.content:encoded: New Mexico has filed a civil lawsuit against the former lawyer and accountant of Jeffrey Epstein to block payments by the late sex offender's estate and recover damages for survivors of his alleged sexual abuse, the state's top law enforcement official said on Wednesday. The suit is the first law enforcement action against Epstein's longtime personal attorney Darren Indyke and accountant Richard Kahn, according to a statement from New Mexico Attorney General Raul Torrez. The lawsuit alleges that Indyke and Kahn facilitated, financed, and concealed Epstein's sex trafficking operation, including at Zorro Ranch, 30 miles south of the state capital of Santa Fe. It also names the estate of Jeffrey Epstein and aims to prohibit his private trust -- created days before his death by suicide in a Manhattan jail cell -- from spending any of the more than $100 million it holds. Indyke and Kahn are co-executors of Epstein's estate. Daniel Weiner, a lawyer representing Indyke and Kahn, rejected allegations the two "knowingly" facilitated Epstein's abuse of women, saying the crimes took place "behind closed doors, in secluded locations" when neither was present. The suit will test whether authorities are able to pin down allegations that a network of people and financial arrangements helped sustain and conceal Epstein's operations. “Jeffrey Epstein did not operate alone, and his death does not end the pursuit of accountability for the people who helped make his crimes possible,” Torrez said at a press conference in Albuquerque. He was joined by two survivors of Epstein's alleged abuse, Julia Molchanova and Anouska De Georgiou. Indyke and Kahn have already been named in civil lawsuits against the Epstein estate, including a complaint last month seeking damages for people pictured in the sex offender's [USN:L6N45814E TEXT:"collection"] of child sexual abuse material. "Not a single woman has ever accused Mr. Indyke or Mr. Kahn of committing sexual abuse or witnessing sexual abuse," Weiner said in a statement, adding that the New Mexico attorney general's office had made no effort to interview the men before filing the lawsuit. New Mexico's lawsuit comes after the Democratic-run state in February [USN:L6N3ZF16Q TEXT:"reopened"] an investigation into activities at Epstein's former New Mexico ranch, where he is accused of abusing women and girls for nearly three decades. New Mexico has [USN:L6N442109 TEXT:"sued"] the US Department of Justice for access to unredacted files on Epstein, accusing the Trump administration of stonewalling its investigation. The DOJ said it provided some files but was [USN:L6N43H116 TEXT:"prevented"] from handing over most material due to privacy protections.

item.title: エジプト大統領「サウジ支援は防衛に限定」、イエメン攻撃は含まれず
item.description: [２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２１日　ロイター] - エジプトのシシ大統領は、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアに対する攻撃を激化させる中、サウジに対するエジプトの軍事支援はサウジの領土と国境の防衛に限定され、イエメンへの攻撃は含まれないと述べた。大統領府が２１日、明らかにした。

サウジ国営通信ＳＰＡによると、シシ氏の発言は、エジプトのアブデルアティ外相とラシャド国家情報局（ＧＩＳ）長官がリヤドで行った、サウジのムハンマド・ビン・サルマン皇太子との会談に合わせて出された。

ＳＰＡによると、アブデルアティ外相はシシ氏からの書簡をサルマン国王に手渡し、両国関係や地域の情勢について協議した。

シシ氏はまた、要請があれば他のアラブ諸国の領土も防衛するとした一方、エジプトの軍事行動はエジプト領内、またはエジプトが安全・安定の保護を目指すアラブ諸国の領内を越えて及ぶことはないと述べた。

エジプトによるサウジへの軍事支援は、中東紛争の大幅な拡大を意味する可能性がある。今年２月に米国とイスラエルがイランを攻撃して以来、世界のエネルギー供給は混乱し、原油価格を押し上げている。

NEW YORK, Oct 21 : BlackRock rolled out another in a suite of exchange-traded funds tied to AI on Wednesday, even as the willingness of investors to wholeheartedly embrace the theme has hit speed bumps. The global asset manager said that its iShares Future Robotics and Related Technologies ETF will invest in companies that use intelligent machines to streamline repetitive tasks in industries such as transportation and manufacturing, which it said represents the next frontier in AI technologies. “Recent volatility is a reminder that AI is not a single trade and that investors need to be deliberate about where and how they take exposure," said Jay Jacobs, US head of equity ETFs at BlackRock. That volatility does not change the firm's conviction on the AI theme, he added. "Expectations can shift quickly, adoption can develop unevenly and market risk remains concentrated in a relatively narrow group of companies," Jacobs said. Moreover, AI has emerged as a driver of both returns and risk even in broad market portfolios.

At least six AI-linked ETFs have made their debut in the past month, many focusing on more narrow AI-related themes rather than offering broad AI products. For instance, Global X recently introduced the LLM ETF, which offers exposure to companies developing new large language models, while Defiance has launched the first ETF to target the bonds of AI infrastructure companies. item.title: Chevron to sharpen US Gulf focus with sale of older assets
item.description: Chevron is exploring the sale of some of its older oil and gas assets in the US Gulf, the company confirmed to Reuters, part of an effort to focus on high-growth developments in the region.
item.dc:creator: David French, Sheila Dang
item.content:encoded: Chevron (CVX.N) is exploring the sale of some of its older oil and gas assets in the US Gulf, the company confirmed to Reuters, part of an effort to focus on high-growth developments in the region. The energy producer is in the early stages of a multi-month process that could see a number of assets offloaded, a Chevron spokesperson said in response to questions from Reuters about the sale effort. "We are initiating the process of marketing some of our mature Gulf of America producing assets, including Petronius, Tubular Bells, and Llano as well as working interest in several other operated and non-operated fields," the spokesperson said. The move is part of Chevron's efforts to ensure its portfolio aligns with the company's priorities, the spokesperson said, adding there was no guarantee that sales would take place. With Chevron targeting production from the US Gulf to grow to 300,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day by the end of this year, the portfolio-trimming efforts indicate Chevron is increasingly focused on newer projects and opportunities in the region. This would include [USN:L1N3JZ01X TEXT:"Anchor"], its first platform producing at ultra-high subsea pressure, and Ballymore, which began production last year. The company is also pursuing exploration to find oil and gas resources near existing facilities, and has been a [USN:L1N3ZZ0X3 TEXT:"top spender"] in recent sales of drilling rights in the US Gulf conducted by the Interior Department. SHARPENING FOCUS Market conditions are favorable for Chevron's pruning efforts. There continues to be heightened buyer interest in American energy production, and asset valuations are supported by elevated oil prices -- US crude touched a six-month high on Tuesday. The sales will likely raise around $1 billion for the company, said two people aware of the sale effort, who spoke on condition of anonymity to discuss confidential deliberations. Buyer interest is expected to come from international operators that specialize in offshore development and that are seeking to grow their US Gulf footprint, as well as US companies focused on the basin. Other energy majors may also show interest, the sources added. Petronius began producing in 2000, and Tubular Bells in 2014, according to Chevron's website. The company owns 100% of Tubular Bells, having initially held 43% but assumed the rest following its takeover of Hess. Chevron operates Petronius with Talos Energy (TALO.N) as its partner in the platform. Chevron's 50% position in Llano was also inherited from Hess. Production from the play, which is operated by Shell (SHEL.L) , started in 2004.

item.title: China’s Chery Picks Omoda C4 as Its First Vehicle to Be Built in South Africa
item.description: By Nqobile Dludla Chinese automaker Chery Group will begin vehicle production in South Africa with its Omoda C4 crossover SUV, deepening its presence in Africa. The Omoda C4 will be produced at the Rosslyn plant near Pretoria, which Chery acquired from Nissan this year. It …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Nqobile Dludla

Chinese automaker Chery Group will begin vehicle production in South Africa with its Omoda C4 crossover SUV, deepening its presence in Africa.

The Omoda C4 will be produced at the Rosslyn plant near Pretoria, which Chery acquired from Nissan this year. It will be offered in gasoline, hybrid and fully electric variants when it launches for sale in South Africa next year, the company said on Wednesday.

Chery said production would be accompanied by a localization program aimed at developing South African suppliers and increasing the proportion of locally sourced components. That chimes with South African initiatives to increase domestic manufacturing and component sourcing.

Chinese automakers including BYD, Chery and Great Wall Motor (GWM) are accelerating their push into overseas markets, including Africa, as slowing growth at home and intense competition in China’s crowded auto sector force manufacturers to seek new buyers abroad.

Beijing Automotive Group (BAIC) has an assembly and manufacturing plant in South Africa while GWM is considering whether to share a manufacturing facility with another carmaker or acquire an existing plant if available.

South Africa, now the continent’s second-biggest automotive manufacturing hub, has become a key target for Chinese brands looking to build market share.

Chery has said it wants to establish South Africa as its African hub for manufacturing, exports, research and development.

The Omoda C4, aimed at younger buyers, will join a growing lineup of models set for local production at the plant, including the Jetour T series of SUVs.

During the ramp-up phase in the third and fourth quarters of 2027, the company expects to produce 15,000 vehicles, rising eventually to 50,000 a year.

item.description: Buyout firm CVC is exploring a bid to take Swedish security firm Verisure private, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday, less than a year after private equity firm Hellman & Friedman floated the company in Stockholm.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Buyout firm CVC (CVC.AS) is exploring a bid to take Swedish security firm Verisure (VSURE.ST) private, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday, less than a year after private equity firm Hellman & Friedman floated the company in Stockholm. Here are some details: Verisure, which provides professionally monitored security services across 18 countries in Europe and Latin America, was listed in October 2025 at a valuation of 13.7 billion euros ($15.39 billion) The company's market value has since fallen to about 9.7 billion euros, according to LSEG data, with its shares down more than 33% so far this year Reuters could not immediately verify the report, while Verisure and CVC declined to comment CVC's interest is at an early stage and there is no certainty a deal will materialise, the report said Hellman & Friedman remains Verisure's largest shareholder with a 43.62% stake, LSEG data show ($1 = 0.8898 euros)

item.title: Giants QB J.J. McCarthy to start vs. Texans
item.description: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy will get the nod over Jameis Winston to start the New York Giants' game against the host Houston Texans on Sunday, coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Quarterback J.J. McCarthy will get the nod over Jameis Winston to start the New York Giants' game against the host Houston Texans on Sunday, coach John Harbaugh said Wednesday. The start would be McCarthy's first since the Giants (3-2-1) acquired him from the Minnesota Vikings on Sept. 28 for a fifth-round pick in the 2027 NFL Draft. McCarthy replaced Winston in the fourth quarter of New York's 34-27 loss to the New Orleans Saints last Sunday. The former completed 11 of 21 passes for 243 yards and led three scoring drives. Signed to a two-year, $13 million contract extension prior to the season, Winston started the previous four games for the Giants in place of the injured Jaxson Dart. Winston, 32, has completed 57.0% of his passes for 957 yards with seven touchdowns and five interceptions in five games this season. McCarthy, 23, has connected on 57.2% of his passes for 1,875 yards with 12 touchdowns and 13 interceptions in 12 career games (10 starts) with the Vikings and Giants. He was selected by the Vikings with the 10th overall pick in the 2024 NFL Draft. He also won a national championship at Michigan while playing for Harbaugh's brother, Jim, now the head coach of the Los Angeles Chargers. --Field Level Media

The move cou

Oct 21 : Sweden is examining whether it can refuse visas to Russian and Belarusian athletes seeking to compete in international sporting events on its soil, the country's migration minister told Reuters on Wednesday, potentially blocking competitors cleared to take part by their governing bodies. The move could prevent athletes granted neutral status from taking part in next year’s Nordic World Ski Championships in the Swedish city of Falun. The biennial championships, featuring cross-country skiing, ski jumping and Nordic combined, are scheduled for February and March. "We are currently analysing the legal grounds on which visas for Russian and Belarusian athletes could be refused," Migration Minister Johan Forssell said in a statement to Reuters. "The Swedish government is strongly critical of Russian and Belarusian athletes being allowed to participate in international competitions," he added.

Forssell said the government supported the position of the Swedish Ski Association and the Swedish Sports Confederation that Russian and Belarusian athletes should not be allowed to compete in Sweden. "There is an obvious risk that this could lead to the normalization of Russia's aggression against Ukraine," he said. The International Ski and Snowboard Federation (FIS) has granted neutral status to several Russian athletes, making them eligible to compete in its events. FIS did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. Russian and Belarusian athletes have faced widespread restrictions in international sport since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, with Belarus serving as a staging ground for Russian forces. Russia has previously challenged international sports bans at the Court of Arbitration for Sport, arguing that decisions to exclude its competitors are unlawful and discriminatory. Reuters has contacted the Russian and Belarusian Olympic committees for comment on the possibility of visa restrictions.   STRONG SWEDISH SUPPORT FOR BAN  Sweden's main sporting bodies back efforts to prevent Russian and Belarusian athletes from competing in the country, while stressing that visa and entry decisions rest with the government. "The Swedish Sports Confederation is in dialogue with the government regarding the regulations for Russian citizens obtaining visas to Sweden," it told Reuters. The Swedish Ski Association said it had maintained the same position since Russia's invasion of Ukraine: athletes from Russia and Belarus should remain excluded from international competition for as long as the war continues. Secretary General Pernilla Bonde said the association had raised the visa issue with the Swedish Sports Confederation, but stressed that entry decisions rested with the authorities. "Decisions regarding visas and entry into Sweden are made by the relevant authorities, not by us," Bonde said, adding the association would comply with any decisions and regulations made by FIS.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion to New Mexico after jury finds company misled consumers about data privacy
item.description: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta Platforms to pay $25 billion on Wednesday after a jury found the company had misled consumers in a case arising from allegations that a political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their consent.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta Platforms (META.O) to pay $25 billion on Wednesday after [USN:L6N45F10O TEXT:"a jury found"] the company had misled consumers in a case arising from allegations that a political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their consent. New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez said it was one of the largest, if not the largest, single state verdict against a company in American history. "Facebook's wrongdoing — over the course of years and systematically broadcast to the public — goes to the heart of Facebook's core business practices," Judge Francis Mathew wrote in his order following the verdict. Mathew found that a penalty of more than $219 billion was warranted, based on state law, but he reduced the figure to $25 billion. In a statement, C.J. Mahoney, Meta's chief legal officer, said the company is confident it will win on appeal. “This ruling, and the Attorney General's approach to this enforcement, makes it all but impossible to do business in the state of New Mexico," Mahoney said. "At its core, this lawsuit seeks to impose a tax on speech to enforce new rules for what people can say online." The company had previously said a penalty in the billions of dollars risked violating its constitutional rights to due process and protection from excessive fines. The penalty is the largest levied against the tech giant in the wake of the Cambridge Analytica scandal. In 2019, the company was hit with [USN:KCN1UJ1L9 TEXT:"a $5 billion penalty"] by the US Federal Trade Commission stemming from the same scandal. Six other states settled their lawsuits related to Cambridge Analytica for $459.2 million as part of a [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"$17.1 billion multistate settlement"] Meta reached in August to resolve states' claims that the company's platforms had harmed teen mental health. LAWSUIT FILED FIVE YEARS AGO New Mexico's attorney general had sued Meta in 2021 following revelations that Cambridge Analytica had [USN:L1N33D09I TEXT:"harvested personal data"] from as many as 87 million Facebook users through a third-party app. The state accused Meta of lying to Facebook users in New Mexico about who had access to their data, how the company handles hate speech and misinformation posted on the platform and other internal policies. The company knew that third parties had broad access to users' personal data, and it tolerated hate speech or other harmful content when it benefited the company's bottom line, the state said. Cambridge Analytica, now defunct, worked for Trump's successful presidential campaign in 2016, and gained access to the personal information from millions of Facebook accounts for the purposes of voter profiling and targeting. It obtained that information without users' consent from a researcher who had been allowed by Facebook to deploy an app on its social media network. "It has been a long time coming holding Big Tech accountable," Torrez told a press conference in Albuquerque after Wednesday's ruling. "I think today's judgment is a clear break with that past and a very clear warning to those in this space and beyond that we intend to protect our people and protect our consumers." Analyst Gil Luria, head of technology research at D.A. Davidson & Co, called the ruling costly but unlikely to impact the company's value. "Meta is worth nearly two trillion dollars, and will likely continue to appeal these cases and drag them out," Luria said. EXPERTS EXPECT LONG APPEAL FIGHT Legal experts and financial analysts said the penalty was likely to face a lengthy battle on appeal. Jurors on September 25 found that 26 of 29 statements made by the company and its leadership on those issues were misleading. They said the company had committed more than 43 million violations of New Mexico’s consumer protection laws, based on the number of Facebook users or New Mexico residents who were the audience for each misleading statement. State law allows a penalty of up to $5,000 per violation, and directs that all of the money go to New Mexico's school system, Torrez told reporters after the verdict. At a hearing on October 1, Randi McGinn, a lawyer for New Mexico, had asked Mathew to award the state between $35 billion and $40 billion, saying that would be supported by the US Constitution's protections on due process and the jury's verdict. "This court should speak to Meta in the only language it understands, which is money, and the value of its stock price," McGinn said. In court filings, Meta urged Mathew to cap the penalties at $3.45 billion, saying a higher penalty ran the risk of scaring businesses out of the state. The evidence showed that Meta does not sell user data and New Mexico did not prove that any consumer had actually been misled, the company said in court filings. Daryl Lim, an associate dean at Penn State Dickinson Law, said that while the US Constitution generally protects against excessive fines, because of the way New Mexico law is written, the large size of the penalty does not automatically mean it could be overturned. TWO JURIES SIDED WITH STATE The verdict was the second in six months by a Santa Fe jury in a lawsuit brought by the state of New Mexico against Meta Platforms. In the first trial, which ended in March, a Santa Fe jury found Meta misled users about young users’ safety on its Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp platforms and ordered the company[USN:L6N40B0XV TEXT:" to pay $375 million"] in civil penalties. After a second phase of that trial, a judge directed the company to [USN:L6N4431IA TEXT:"pay $567 million"] into a New Mexico fund for teen mental health and ordered Meta to implement measures to protect teen Facebook and Instagram users in New Mexico. (This story has been corrected to say 'a company,' not 'the company,' in New Mexico attorney general's comment, in paragraph 2.)

ROME, Oct 21 : Italy have recalled eight players and handed Mattia Midena a first call-up in a 34-man squad for next month’s Nations Championship, but will be without 12 others through injury. • Loose forward Lorenzo Cannone, who was injured in the test against New Zealand in Wellington in July, returns to the squad along with Simone Ferrari and Manuel Zuliani while there are recalls for backs Mirko Belloni, Matt Gallagher, Damiano Mazza, Giovanni Montemauri and Federico Mori as well as English-based lock Enoch Opoku Gyamfi. • Mazza and Montemauri are uncapped as are Samuele Locatelli and Mattia Midena, who gets his first call-up. • Italy, who will be at home to South Africa, Argentina and Fiji next month before the finals weekend at Twickenham, will be without Tommaso Menoncello, who hurt his shoulder last weekend playing for French club Stade Toulouse in the European Champions Cup against Exeter Chiefs, and powerful loose forward Sebastian Negri.

item.title: オープンＡＩ社長、ＡＩ規制反対派に2500万ドル寄付 真意に疑問
item.description:
Courtney Rozen
[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Courtney Rozen

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩのブロックマン社長が、ＡＩ規制強化に反対する政治団体「リーディング・ザ・フューチャー」に対し、夫婦で計２５００万ドルを寄付したことが取り沙汰されている。オープンＡＩを巡っては、開発中のＡＩエージェントがシステムに不正侵入する問題が発生。経営陣は連邦政府による規制を訴えている中での多額の寄付の存在が明らかになり、米政府による規制導入を望んでいるのかどうか真意をいぶかる声が出ている。

団体は米国での「ＡＩ開発を過度に制約あるいは遅らせる」規制に反対を掲げ、１１月の米中間選挙に向けて、連邦議会上下両院の少なくとも４８の選挙区に絡んで数百万ドルを投じている。広報担当は「強力かつ責任ある国レベルの規制枠組みを推進するため、議会で協力できる支持者」を求めていると表明したが、寄付に関しては言及しなかった。

オープンＡＩはブログで、ブロックマン夫妻の寄付は個人的なものだと説明している。

トランプ米大統領は今年９月、オープンＡＩほかＡＩ開発主要６社とＡＩの脅威に自主的に対処するとの合意を発表した。規制強化をすれば、新モデルの発表遅延や安全面の懸念による性能変更などにつながり、業界の利益を損なう可能性がある。アンソロピックは、連邦規制が州法に優先することに反対する政治団体に、少なくとも４０００万ドルを寄付している。

item.title: 情報ＢＯＸ：ＰＨＰの重大脆弱性、リスクと発見経緯
item.description:
Leo Marchandon
[２１日 ロイター] - 欧州各地で２１日、政府ウェブサイトの停止が相次いだ。ウェブで最...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
情報ＢＯＸ：ＰＨＰの重大脆弱性、リスクと発見経緯 1:40 配信

2026年10月21日、ドイツ・ベルリン。REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

Leo Marchandon

[２１日 ロイター] - 欧州各地で２１日、政府ウェブサイトの停止が相次いだ。ウェブで最も広く使われているプログラミング言語の一つ、ＰＨＰ（ハイパーテキスト・プリプロセッサ）で２件の重大な脆弱性が見つかったためだ。

以下に押さえておくべきポイントをまとめた。

＜ＰＨＰとは＞

ＰＨＰはウェブサイトを動かすプログラミング言語で、利用者から見えないところで働いている。利用者がページを読み込むと、ＰＨＰが稼働するサーバーがコンテンツを組み立て、完成したページをブラウザーに送る。

無料のオープンソースソフトウエアで、ボランティアが保守している。サイトの所有者が直接操作することはほとんどない。

ウェブ技術の調査サービス「Ｗ３Ｔｅｃｈｓ」によると、使用するプログラミング言語を特定できるウェブサイトの７０％近くがＰＨＰで動いている。ＰＨＰは、全ウェブサイトの約４０％を支えるソフトウエア「ワードプレス」の基盤でもある。これらにはブログ、中小企業のページ、政府のポータルサイト、オンラインショップ、ニュースサイトなどが含まれる。

＜脆弱性のリスクは＞

２件の脆弱性は、業界標準の深刻度評価システム「ＣＶＳＳ」のバージョン４．０で、１０点満点中９．２点と評価されている。ＥＵのサイバーセキュリティー対応チーム「ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵ」によると、この評価は認証なしで遠隔からコードを実行できることを示す。つまり、攻撃者はパスワードやアカウントがなくても、インターネット経由で脆弱なサーバー上でコマンドを実行できる。

ＰＨＰに一つの欠陥があるだけで、数百万台のサーバーに一斉に同じ侵入口が開かれる。欠陥を悪用すれば、ウェブサイトを支配できる。ウェブホスティングサービスのゴーダディによると、データの盗難やページの改ざん、システム全体の乗っ取りにつながる恐れがある。クラウドフレアの最高技術責任者は、初期の攻撃が発生し始めていると述べた。

小規模なウェブサイトの大半は通常、セキュリティー担当者のいない所有者が運営している。共用ホスティングサービスを利用していることも多く、その場合、所有者はサーバーを管理しておらず、誰がＰＨＰを更新するのか把握していない可能性がある。ワードプレス向けのセキュリティープラグイン「ワードフェンス」は、通常の自動更新では今回の修正は適用されないと警告した。ＣＥＲＴ－ＥＵは、影響を受けるサイトを危険にさらしたままにせず、公開を停止するよう勧告している。

＜どのように発見されたのか＞

セキュリティー企業カリフによると、オープンＡＩと協力する同社の研究者が、オープンＡＩのモデル「ＧＰＴ－５．６ Ｓｏｌ」を使って最初の欠陥を発見し、８月１１日にＰＨＰ側に報告した。アルファベット傘下グーグルが保有するセキュリティー企業ウィズも独自に欠陥を発見し、８月２４日に２件目を報告した。同社も人工知能（ＡＩ）モデルを使用した。

ウィズは、今回の欠陥について「ＰＨＰで見つかった脆弱性の中でも最も深刻な部類に入り、ソフトウエアの歴史全体でもそう言えるだろう」と説明した。根本的な欠陥は数十年前から存在していたが、悪用できると実証するには「人間の研究者が現実的に達成できる限界に近い」一連の手順が必要だったという。

トランプ米政権は「状況を注視し、修正プログラムの公開を早めるため、連邦機関や主要なＳＩ研究機関と調整している」と表明した。ＳＩは、トランプ氏が人工知能を指して好んで使う「超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス）」の略称。政権は今回の発見を、米国の「超知能」が国家安全保障を強化している証拠と位置付けた。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 焦点：「ミュトス」登場で米銀はシステム修正に奔走、サービスに影響も 最終更新: 10/22(木) 1:40 ロイター

item.title: El rendimiento de los bonos franceses alcanza el 5%, su nivel más alto desde 2002
item.description: El aumento de los precios de la energía y las dudas sobre la capacidad del Gobierno para aprobar un presupuesto que aborde la deuda pública impulsan los rendimientos de los bonos franceses.
item.dc:creator: Alice Atkins
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — La rentabilidad de la deuda francesa de referencia alcanzó el 5% por primera vez desde 2002, a medida que el aumento de los precios de la energía exacerbó la preocupación por las perspectivas fiscales del país. Los bonos gubernamentales con vencimiento a 10 años retrocedieron el miércoles, lo que provocó un aumento de siete puntos básicos en su rendimiento. Esto contribuyó a ampliar la diferencia entre los rendimientos de los bonos franceses y alemanes a 159,4 puntos básicos, la mayor en 15 años. Ver más: Francia admite fallos de inteligencia tras subestimar la magnitud de las protestas Considerado un indicador clave del riesgo crediticio en la zona euro, el diferencial ha aumentado drásticamente desde finales de septiembre, a medida que se cuestiona cada vez más la capacidad de Francia para aprobar un presupuesto que aborde su carga de deuda. La indignación pública por el coste de la vida degeneró en violentas protestas durante el fin de semana. “Es probable que los diferenciales sigan bajo presión a medida que la atención se centra de nuevo en las próximas votaciones presupuestarias”, declaró Pooja Kumra, estratega sénior de tipos de interés para el Reino Unido y Europa en el Toronto Dominion Bank. “Incluso si se aprueba el presupuesto, a los inversores les siguen preocupando los indicios generales de disfunción fiscal y fragmentación política”. El miércoles, el alza de los precios de la energía impulsó la evolución de los bonos europeos, con los futuros de referencia del gas natural europeo subiendo alrededor de un 4% y el petróleo crudo Brent cotizando cerca de los 110 dólares por barril. En declaraciones realizadas a primera hora del día, el consejero delegado de Deutsche Bank AG, Christian Sewing, destacó la inestabilidad fiscal y política en Francia como motivo de preocupación , y señaló que es probable que la volatilidad continúe hasta las elecciones presidenciales del próximo año. Ver más: Macron acusa a líderes extranjeros de aprovecharse de los disturbios en Francia “Unos mayores rendimientos de la deuda soberana global también perjudicarían a los bonos franceses, dada su mayor sensibilidad a las fluctuaciones de sus pares. Preveo que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense y de los bonos alemanes a largo plazo aumentarán debido al gasto deficitario y la inflación descontrolada, lo que deja a los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense especialmente vulnerables”. — Ven Ram, estratega de activos múltiples. Ver más: Los disturbios en Francia pierden fuerza tras el endurecimiento de las medidas de seguridad El euro tuvo un rendimiento inferior al de la mayoría de las monedas del Grupo de los 10 frente al dólar, llegando a caer hasta un 0,2%, situándose en 1,1214 dólares. El Parlamento francés está profundamente dividido, y alcanzar un compromiso sobre el presupuesto del próximo año que permita la aprobación de los proyectos de ley está resultando una tarea ardua. A tan solo seis meses de las elecciones presidenciales, es poco probable que el proceso se simplifique. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: eBay despedirá a unos 1.000 empleados en su segunda ronda de recortes de 2026
item.description: Los recortes afectarán a cerca del 9% de la plantilla de la compañía, según una fuente familiarizada con el asunto. En febrero, eBay anunció la eliminación de unos 800 puestos de trabajo.
item.dc:creator: Spencer Soper
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Según una persona familiarizada con el asunto, eBay Inc. ( EBAY ) eliminará el 9% de su plantilla, lo que supone la segunda ronda de recortes de empleo de la compañía este año. Según la fuente, que pidió permanecer en el anonimato porque los detalles no son públicos, los recortes afectarán a unos 1.000 empleados. Reuters informó previamente sobre los despidos, citando un memorando interno del director ejecutivo de la empresa. Ver más: eBay rechaza la oferta de GameStop por no ser “ni creíble ni atractiva” “Mientras trabajamos para aprovechar la importante oportunidad que tenemos por delante, tomamos esta medida para garantizar que sigamos operando desde una posición de fortaleza, alineando nuestros equipos y recursos con nuestras principales prioridades estratégicas”, dijo un portavoz de eBay en un comunicado enviado por correo electrónico. Las acciones de la compañía subieron aproximadamente un 1,2% a las 11:05 de la mañana en Nueva York. En mayo, eBay rechazó una oferta de adquisición de US$56.000 millones del CEO de Gamestop Corp., Ryan Cohen, calificando la oferta de “ni creíble ni atractiva”. Al presentar la oferta, Cohen se comprometió a encontrar ahorros de costes por valor de US$2.000 millones en los 12 meses posteriores al cierre del acuerdo y sugirió que el gasto en marketing del CEO e eBay, Jamie Iannone, había sido un despilfarro. Ver más: eBay sube 5% tras oferta de GameStop, pero dudas de Wall Street afectan opción de inversión Iannone, que asumió el cargo de director ejecutivo en 2020, se ha centrado en impulsar las ventas en categorías selectas, como artículos de lujo, productos reacondicionados y objetos de colección. Estas últimas reducciones se suman a una ronda de recortes de personal en febrero, cuando eBay anunció la eliminación de unos 800 puestos de trabajo, lo que representaba el 6% de su plantilla en aquel momento. La compañía también redujo su personal a principios de 2023 y principios de 2024. Ver más: La jugada del CEO de GameStop: qué busca con su oferta de US$56.000 millones por eBay A principios de este año, eBay adquirió Depop, una plataforma de venta de moda de segunda mano, una operación que se espera ayude a eBay a competir con la emergente empresa lituana Vinted, que se está expandiendo en Estados Unidos. En agosto, eBay anunció que la adquisición de Depop ascendía a US$200 millones más de lo anunciado inicialmente, lo que podría afectar a sus ganancias en el tercer trimestre. La empresa tiene previsto presentar sus resultados financieros el 28 de octubre. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Vers une reprise des discussions trilatérales entre USA, Russie et Ukraine
item.description: La Russie a accepté la proposition des Etats-Unis d'organiser une réunion trilatérale au niveau technique avec l'Ukraine, a déclaré mercredi un représentant américain, tandis que le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a dit soutenir cette démarche et vouloir que les discussions se tiennent au plus tôt.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Russie a accepté la proposition des Etats-Unis d'organiser une réunion trilatérale au niveau technique avec l'Ukraine, a déclaré mercredi un représentant américain, tandis que le président ukrainien Volodimir Zelensky a dit soutenir cette démarche et vouloir que les discussions se tiennent au plus tôt. Ces commentaires ont été effectués à la suite d'une visite en Russie de Steve Witkoff, émissaire spécial du président américain Donald Trump, lors de laquelle il a rencontré le président russe Vladimir Poutine. Ils s'inscrivent dans un contexte d'inquiétudes à Kyiv et parmi ses alliés à propos d'un possible virage entrepris par Washington au détriment de l'Ukraine, alors que les Etats-Unis ont un temps suspendu le partage de renseignements avec les autorités ukrainiennes à propos des bombardements de la Russie. Donald Trump a également annoncé plus tôt ce mois-ci être convenu lors d'un entretien téléphonique avec Vladimir Poutine d'un accord sur des [USN:L8N45V1O6 TEXT:"livraisons de diesel"], ce qui a provoqué un tollé de la part de responsables ukrainiens et européens ainsi que d'élus démocrates et républicains au Congrès américain. Le Kremlin a fait savoir mercredi que Vladimir Poutine a accepté de reprendre les efforts de paix chapeautés par les Etats-Unis pour mettre fin à la guerre, entrée en février dernier dans sa cinquième année. Ces discussions trilatérales au niveau technique pourraient avoir lieu à Abou Dhabi, qui a déjà accueilli un précédent cycle de pourparlers, et se focaliseraient sur des garanties sécuritaires apportées à la Russie et à l'Ukraine une fois la guerre terminée, a ajouté la présidence russe. Elles pourraient se tenir autour du 10 novembre, a-t-elle indiqué. Volodimir Zelensky a dit par la suite que Kyiv soutenait la proposition de Washington et souhaitait au plus vite une rencontre entre des négociateurs des trois pays. "Le camp américain nous propose de tenir (cette réunion) dès que possible et nous y sommes favorables", a dit le président ukrainien à des journalistes au cours d'un échange via la messagerie WhatsApp, ajoutant avoir été informé par des représentants américains que la Russie "soutenait" l'idée. Les Américains "vont tout faire pour garantir que la réunion se tienne au plus vite, en novembre, je pense au plus tard début novembre", a-t-il ajouté. NEUVIÈME RENCONTRE WITKOFF-POUTINE EN RUSSIE Volodimir Zelensky, qui s'était entretenu mardi avec Steve Witkoff lors d'une réunion en Norvège à laquelle ont également pris part des responsables européens, a souligné que Kyiv soutenait "toute proposition de cessez-le-feu, pour mettre fin à la guerre, des trêves énergétiques". Il avait répété plus tôt être [USN:L6N4670YO TEXT:"disposé à dialoguer"]. Aucun cycle de pourparlers trilatéraux n'a été organisé depuis le début de la guerre entre les Etats-Unis et l'Iran, le 28 février dernier. Quelques jours plus tôt, à Abou Dhabi, les délégations ukrainienne et russe étaient convenues d'un [USN:L8N3Z113X TEXT:"échange de prisonniers"], sans avancer toutefois sur les principaux points de contentieux. Revenu au pouvoir à la Maison blanche en janvier 2025, Donald Trump avait promis de mettre fin à la guerre en Ukraine en "seulement vingt-quatre heures". Il a rétabli les contacts directs avec Moscou, rompus par son prédécesseur Joe Biden en raison du conflit, et pris part l'an dernier à un [USN:L8N3U8008 TEXT:"sommet bilatéral"] avec Vladimir Poutine n'ayant débouché sur aucune mesure de paix. Les positions de l'Ukraine et de la Russie demeurent très éloignées sur les contours d'un potentiel accord. Alors que Volodimir Zelensky écarte l'idée d'abandonner tout territoire ukrainien à Moscou, Vladimir Poutine exige le plein contrôle de la région de Donetsk dans l'Est ukrainien, la garantie que Kyiv n'intégrera pas l'Otan et des restrictions sur les capacités militaires ukrainiennes. Donald Trump, qui s'en était vivement pris à Volodimir Zelensky lors d'une rencontre à la Maison blanche en février 2025, a déclaré cette semaine qu'il serait opportun que l'Ukraine se trouve un nouvel interlocuteur pour négocier et qu'il était temps de mettre fin à la guerre avant que "de mauvaises choses se passent". Steve Witkoff a rencontré mercredi Vladimir Poutine pour la neuvième fois en tant qu'émissaire spécial. Leur réunion, au Grand palais impérial de Saint-Pétersbourg, a duré près de trois heures. Elle a donné lieu notamment à ce qui a été présenté comme un "geste de bonne volonté" de la part du président russe: la libération du ressortissant américain [USN:L6N4670TT TEXT:"Stephen Hubbard"], emprisonné en Russie depuis 2022. Kirill Dmitriev, conseiller spécial du Kremlin qui a également pris part aux discussions, a déclaré que d'importants projets économiques communs ont été évoqués.

item.title: What is PHP and why did it take government websites offline?
item.description: Government websites across Europe went dark on Wednesday as operators raced to patch two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, one of the most widely used programming languages on the web.
item.dc:creator: Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: Government websites across Europe went dark on Wednesday as operators raced to patch two critical vulnerabilities in PHP, one of the most widely used programming languages on the web. The developers of PHP said on Wednesday they would release patches for two critical vulnerabilities, and EU cybersecurity officials warned organisations unable to apply the fixes to take affected websites offline. Here is what you need to know: WHAT IS PHP? PHP is a programming language that runs websites. It works behind the scenes. When a user loads a page, the server running PHP assembles the content and sends the finished page to the browser. It is free, open source and maintained by volunteers. Site owners rarely interact with it directly. PHP runs nearly 70% of all websites whose programming language can be identified, according to web technology tracker W3Techs. It is the engine behind WordPress, the software that powers about 40% of all websites such as blogs, small business pages, government portals, online shops and news sites. WHAT ARE THE RISKS OF THE FLAWS? The two vulnerabilities are rated 9.2 out of 10 on the CVSS v4.0 severity scale, a standard industry scoring system. CERT-EU, the European Union's cybersecurity response team, said that rating signals unauthenticated remote code execution, meaning an attacker can run commands on a vulnerable server, over the internet, with no password or account. A single flaw in PHP opens the same door on millions of servers at once. Whoever exploits the flaw controls the website. GoDaddy (GDDY.N) , a web hosting provider, said that could mean stolen data, defaced pages or full-system compromise. Cloudflare's (NET.N) chief technology officer said early attacks were emerging. Most small websites are typically run by owners with no security staff, often on shared hosting where they do not manage the server and may not know who updates PHP. Wordfence, a security plugin for WordPress sites, warned that the usual automatic updates will not apply this fix. CERT-EU's guidance is to take affected sites offline rather than leave them exposed. HOW WAS IT FOUND? Researchers at security firm Calif, working with OpenAI, reported the first flaw to PHP on August 11 after finding it with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol model, the company said. Wiz, a security firm owned by Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Google, found the flaws independently and reported a second one on August 24, also using AI models. Wiz said the findings "rank among the most severe vulnerabilities discovered in PHP, and arguably in software history." The underlying flaws had been present for decades, the firm said, but proving they were exploitable required a chain of steps "at the edge of what human researchers could practically achieve." US President Donald Trump's administration said it was "tracking and coordinating with federal agencies and leading SI labs to expedite the release of the fix," referring to Trump's preferred name for artificial intelligence. It framed the discovery as evidence that American "Super Intelligence" strengthens national security.
